entries.literal: On guiyou Heaven's Strategy supreme general, Hunan military commissioner, Palace Opener, Grand Preceptor, concurrent Secretariat Director, and Prince of Chu Ma Yin was advanced to acting Grand Preceptor and Grand Secretariat Director.

entries.zh: 兩浙節度留後、靜海軍節度、嶺南西道觀察處置等使、檢校太尉、兼中書令錢元瓘加食邑。
entries.en: Qian Yuanguan of Liangzhe received added fief income.
entries.literal: Liangzhe acting military commissioner, Jinghai army commissioner, Lingnan West observation commissioner, acting Grand Guardian, and concurrent Secretariat Director Qian Yuanguan received added fief income.

entries.zh: 中吳建武等軍節度、嶺南東道觀察處置等使、檢校太尉、兼中書令錢元尞加開府階，進食邑。
entries.en: Qian Yuanliao of central Wu gained opening-office rank and added fief income.
entries.literal: Zhongwu and Jianwu army military commissioner of central Wu, Lingnan East observation commissioner, acting Grand Guardian, and concurrent Secretariat Director Qian Yuanliao received opening-office rank and advanced fief income.

entries.zh: 甲戌，以前代州刺史馬溉為左衛上將軍致仕。
entries.en: On jiaxu Ma Gai, former Dai prefect, became Left Guard upper general emeritus.
entries.literal: On jiaxu former Dai prefect Ma Gai was made Left Guard upper general and retired.

entries.zh: 己卯，以光祿卿羅周敬為右金吾衛大將軍，充街使。
entries.en: On jimao Luo Zhoujing of Palace Supplies became Right Golden Crow great general and street commissioner.
entries.literal: On jimao Director of the Palace Supplies Luo Zhoujing was made Right Golden Crow guard great general and charged as street commissioner.

entries.zh: 辛巳，以前復州刺史袁{山義}為唐州刺史。
entries.en: On xinsi Yuan Yan, former Fu prefect, became Tang prefect.
entries.literal: On xinsi former Fu prefect Yuan Yan was made Tang prefect.

entries.zh: 詔曰：「鳳翔節度使李嚴，世聯宗屬，任重藩宣，慶善有稱，忠勤顯著。
entries.en: An edict said: "Fengxiang military commissioner Li Yan is a kinsman by marriage and shows marked loyalty and diligence on the frontier.
entries.literal: An edict said: "Fengxiang military commissioner Li Yan is of our clan by marriage, bears heavy frontier responsibility, is praised for kindness, and shows marked loyalty and diligence.

entries.zh: 既在維城之列，宜新定體之文。
entries.en: As one who shored up the realm, he deserved new honors.
entries.literal: Since he stands among those who shore up the realm, he should receive new forms of honor.

entries.zh: 是降寵光，以隆惇敘，俾煥成家之美，貴崇猶子之親。
entries.en: Mingzong would exalt kinship and honor him as an imperial nephew.
entries.literal: Therefore We lower favor and glory to exalt kinship, that he may shine with the beauty of a completed household and honor the closeness of an imperial nephew.

entries.zh: 宜於本名上加『從』字。」
entries.en: The character "Cong" was to be added before his given name."
entries.literal: The character "Cong" should be added before his given name."

entries.zh: 癸未，文武百僚至張全義私第柩前立班辭，以來月二日葬故也。
entries.en: On guiwei officials lined up at Zhang Quanyi's house to mourn before his burial on the second of the next month.
entries.literal: On guiwei the civil and military hundred officials lined up at Zhang Quanyi's private residence before the bier to take leave, because burial was set for the second of next month.

entries.zh: 庚子，幽州奏，契丹平州守將偽署幽州節度使盧文進，率戶口歸順，百僚稱賀。
entries.en: On gengzi Youzhou said Khitan Ping commander and false Youzhou commissioner Lu Wenjin had defected with his people, and the court congratulated.
entries.literal: On gengzi Youzhou reported that the Khitan Ping Prefecture garrison commander, the false Youzhou military commissioner Lu Wenjin, had led households to submit; the hundred officials congratulated.

entries.zh: 辛丑，契丹遣使來告哀，言國主安巴堅以今年七月二十七日卒。
entries.en: On xinchou Khitan envoys announced mourning for ruler Ambaqian, who had died on the twenty-seventh of the seventh month.
entries.literal: On xinchou the Khitan sent envoys to announce mourning, saying their ruler Ambaqian had died on the twenty-seventh of the seventh month this year.

entries.zh: 詔曰：「朕近纘皇圖，恭修帝道，務安夷夏，貴洽雍熙。
entries.en: An edict said: "I have lately succeeded to the imperial design and seek harmony between Chinese and barbarians.
entries.literal: An edict said: "We have lately succeeded to the imperial design and respectfully cultivate the imperial Way, striving to settle Yi and Xia and value harmonious peace.

entries.zh: 契丹王世預歡盟，禮交聘問，遽聞凶訃，倍軫悲懷，可輟今月十九日朝參。」
entries.en: The Khitan had long exchanged envoys; hearing of Ambaqian's death, Mingzong suspended court on the nineteenth."
entries.literal: The Khitan ruler for generations has cherished alliance and ritual exchange of envoys; suddenly hearing this bereavement, Our grief is doubled—court attendance on the nineteenth of this month may be suspended."

entries.zh: 丙午，以巂州山後兩林、百蠻都鬼主李卑晚為寧遠將軍，大渡河山前邛川六姓都鬼主、懷安郡王勿鄧摽莎為定遠將軍。
entries.en: On bingwu Li Beiwan, great ghost-lord of the Two Forests and Hundred Clans behind Mount Wushan in Qiong Prefecture, became General Pacifying the Distant; Wudeng Biaosha, Prince of Huai'an and great ghost-lord of the six Qiongchuan clans before Mount Dadu, became General Stabilizing the Distant.
entries.literal: On bingwu Li Beiwan, great ghost-lord of the Two Forests and Hundred Clans behind Mount Wushan in Qiong, was made Pacification-Remote general; the great ghost-lord of the six Qiongchuan clans before Mount Dadu in Huai'an, Prince of Huai'an Wudeng Biaosha, was made Pacification-Distant general.

entries.zh: 丁未，幽州奏，盧文進所率降戶孳畜人口在平州西，首尾約七十里。
entries.en: On dingwei Youzhou said Lu Wenjin's defectors with their herds stretched seventy li west of Ping.
entries.literal: On dingwei Youzhou reported that livestock and people among Lu Wenjin's surrendered households west of Ping Prefecture stretched in a line about seventy li.

entries.zh: 庚戌，以吏部侍郎盧文紀為御史中丞，時御史大夫李琪三上表求解任故也。
entries.en: On gengxu Lu Wenji became censor-in-chief after Li Qi three times asked to resign the post.
entries.literal: On gengxu Personnel Vice Director Lu Wenji was made Censor-in-Chief, because Censor-in-Chief Li Qi three times memorialized asking to be relieved of his post.

entries.zh: 以兵部侍郎劉嶽為吏部侍郎，以戶部侍郎、充端明殿學士馮道為兵部侍郎，以中書舍人、充端明殿學士趙鳳為戶部侍郎，並依前充職。
entries.en: Liu Yue moved from War to Personnel; Feng Dao from Revenue to War while keeping Duanming Hall; Zhao Feng from drafting to Revenue while keeping Duanming—all at rank.
entries.literal: Vice Minister of War Liu Yue was made Minister of Personnel; Vice Minister of Revenue and Duanming Hall academician Feng Dao was made Vice Minister of War; Secretariat drafting officer and Duanming Hall academician Zhao Feng was made Vice Minister of Revenue—all continuing their former concurrent posts.

entries.zh: 壬子，靜江軍節度使、桂州管內觀察使、檢校太師、兼中書令、扶風郡王馬賨加食邑實封，澧郎觀察使、檢校太傅、兼侍中馬希振加檢校太尉。
entries.en: On renzi Ma Cong of Jingjiang and Guizhou—acting Grand Preceptor, Secretariat director, and Prince of Fufeng—gained fief and enfeoffment; Ma Xizhen of Li-Lang—acting Grand Tutor and Palace Attendant—became acting Grand Guardian.
entries.literal: On renzi, Jingjiang army military commissioner, Guizhou circuit surveillance commissioner, acting Grand Preceptor, concurrent Secretariat Director, Prince of Fufeng Ma Cong gained added fief households and enfeoffment; Li-Lang surveillance commissioner, acting Grand Tutor, concurrent Palace Attendant Ma Xizhen was made acting Grand Guardian.

entries.zh: 盧文進至幽州，遣軍吏奉表來上。
entries.en: Lu Wenjin reached Youzhou and sent a staff officer with a memorial to court.
entries.literal: Lu Wenjin reached Youzhou and sent a military clerk to present a memorial to the court.

entries.zh: 十一月戊午，以滄州留後王景戡為邢州節度使。
entries.en: On wuwu in the eleventh month Wang Jingzhan, Cangzhou deputy regent, became Xing military commissioner.
entries.literal: Eleventh month, wuwu: Cangzhou deputy regent Wang Jingzhan was made Xingzhou military commissioner.

entries.zh: 青州奏，得登州狀申，契丹先攻逼渤海國，自安巴堅身死，雖已抽退，尚留兵馬在渤海扶餘城，今渤海王弟領兵馬攻圍扶餘城內契丹次。
entries.en: Qingzhou relayed Dengzhou's report: the Khitan had attacked Bohai; after Abaoji died they pulled back but left troops at Fuyu; the Bohai king's brother now besieged the Khitan there.
entries.literal: Qingzhou reported that Dengzhou had memorialized: the Khitan had first pressed Bohai; since An Ba Jian's death they had withdrawn but still left troops at Bohai's Fuyu city; now the Bohai king's brother led troops besieging the Khitan camp within Fuyu city.

entries.zh: 己未，以翰林學士、尚書、戶部郎中、知制誥劉句為中書舍人充職。
entries.en: On jiwei Liu Gou—Hanlin academician, Master of Writing, Revenue director, and edict drafter—became Secretariat drafting officer at rank.
entries.literal: On jiwei, Hanlin academician, Master of Writing, Revenue bureau director, and edict drafter Liu Gou was made Secretariat drafting officer at his post.

entries.zh: 辛酉，以前秘書少監溫輦為太子詹事。
entries.en: On xinyou former Secretariat vice director Wen Nian became crown prince mentor.
entries.literal: On xinyou, former Secretariat vice director Wen Nian was made crown prince household mentor.

entries.zh: 壬戌，以前房州刺史朱罕為潁州團練使。
entries.en: On renxu Zhu Han, former Fang prefect, became Ying training commissioner.
entries.literal: On renxu, former Fangzhou prefect Zhu Han was made Yingzhou training commissioner.

entries.zh: 是日，詔曰：「應今日已前修蓋得寺院，無令毀廢；
entries.en: That day an edict said: "Monasteries already built by today must not be torn down;
entries.literal: That day an edict said: "Monasteries built and completed on or before today must not be destroyed;

entries.zh: 自此已後，不得輒有建造。
entries.en: from now on none may be built without leave.
entries.literal: from this day forward there must be no rash new construction.

entries.zh: 如要願在僧門，並須官壇受戒，不得衷私剃度。」
entries.en: Anyone entering the clergy must take ordination at the official altar—private tonsure is forbidden."
entries.literal: Those who wish to enter the clergy must all receive ordination at the official altar and may not be privately tonsured."

entries.zh: 癸丑，日南至，帝御文明殿受朝賀，仗衛如式。
entries.en: On guichou, the winter solstice, Mingzong received court at Wenhua Hall with full guard and insignia.
entries.literal: On guichou, the winter solstice, the Emperor received congratulatory audience at Wenhua Hall; guards and insignia followed the regulations.

entries.zh: 禮部侍郎裴皞上言：「諸州刺史經三考方請替移。」
entries.en: Vice Minister of Rites Pei Hao said: "Circuit prefects should finish three reviews before seeking transfer."
entries.literal: Minister of Rites vice director Pei Hao memorialized: "Prefects of the circuits should, after three performance reviews, only then request transfer."

entries.zh: 詔曰：「有政聲者就加恩澤，無課最者即便替移。」
entries.en: An edict said: "Reward those with a reputation for good rule; replace those without measurable results at once."
entries.literal: An edict said: "Those with political renown should at once receive favor; those without measurable achievement should be replaced immediately."

entries.zh: 密州獻芝草。
entries.en: Mizhou presented lingzhi.
entries.literal: Mizhou presented lingzhi fungus.

entries.zh: 庚午，河陽節度使夏魯奇移鎮許州，留後梁漢顒為邠州節度使。
entries.en: On gengwu Xia Luqi of Heyang moved to Xu; deputy regent Liang Hanyuan became Bin military commissioner.
entries.literal: On gengwu, Heyang military commissioner Xia Luqi was transferred to Xu; deputy regent Liang Hanyuan was made Bin military commissioner.

entries.zh: 淮南楊溥遣使貢獻，賀登極。
entries.en: Yang Pu of Huainan sent envoys with tribute to congratulate the throne.
entries.literal: Huainan's Yang Pu sent envoys with tribute congratulating the enthronement.

entries.zh: 乙亥，以前振武留後張溫為利州昭武軍留後，以果州刺史孫鐸為漢州刺史，充西川馬步軍都指揮使。
entries.en: On yihai Zhang Wen, former Zhenwu deputy regent, became Li Zhaowu deputy regent; Sun Duo of Guo became Han prefect and western Shu horse-and-foot commander.
entries.literal: On yihai, former Zhenwu deputy regent Zhang Wen was made Lizhou Zhaowu army deputy regent; Guo prefect Sun Duo was made Han prefect and charged as western Shu horse-and-foot overall commander.

entries.zh: 壬午，靜海軍節度、安南管內觀察等使、檢校太尉、兼侍中錢元球加開府階，進食邑。
entries.en: On renwu Qian Yuanqiu of Jinghai and Annan—acting Grand Guardian and Palace Attendant—gained open-office rank and added fief.
entries.literal: On renwu, Jinghai army military commissioner, Annan circuit surveillance commissioner, acting Grand Guardian, concurrent Palace Attendant Qian Yuanqiu gained open-office rank and added fief.

entries.zh: 癸未，鎮州奏，準詔盧文進所率歸業戶口，蠲放租稅三年，仍每口給糧五斗。
entries.en: On guimou Zhenzhou reported that per edict Lu Wenjin's submitting households had three years' tax remitted and five dou of grain per person.
entries.literal: On guimou, Zhenzhou reported that per the edict the households Lu Wenjin had led in submission had taxes remitted for three years and each person was given five dou of grain.

entries.zh: 天成元年秋八月乙酉朔，日有食之。
entries.en: On the yiyou new moon of the eighth month of Tiancheng 1 there was a solar eclipse.
entries.literal: In autumn, eighth month, yiyou new moon of Tiancheng 1, there was a solar eclipse.

entries.zh: 有司上言：「莊宗廟室酌獻，請奏武成之舞。」
entries.en: The ritual offices asked: "We ask to perform the Wucheng dance at Zhuangzong's libation offering."
entries.literal: The relevant offices memorialized: "For Zhuangzong's temple chamber libation offering, we ask to perform the Wucheng dance."

entries.zh: 從之。
entries.en: Approved.
entries.literal: It was approved.

entries.zh: 鄆州節度使霍彥威移鎮青州。
entries.en: Huo Yanwei moved from Yan to Qing as military commissioner.
entries.literal: Yanzhou military commissioner Huo Yanwei was transferred to Qingzhou.

entries.zh: 丁亥，莊宗神主祔廟，有司請祧懿祖室，從之。
entries.en: On dinghai Zhuangzong's tablet entered the temple; the court asked to retire the Yizu chamber and Mingzong agreed.
entries.literal: On dinghai Zhuangzong's spirit tablet was enshrined in the temple; the relevant offices asked to remove the Yizu chamber, and it was approved.

entries.zh: 詔：「陵州、合州長流百姓豆盧革、韋說等，可並自長流後，縱逢恩赦，不在原宥之限。
entries.en: An edict said: "The long-exiled Dou Luge and Wei Shuo of Ling and He are barred from ever benefiting from amnesty.
entries.literal: An edict said: "The long-exiled commoners Dou Luge and Wei Shuo of Ling and He prefectures may, after their long exile ends, never be included in any amnesty restoration.

entries.zh: 豆盧升、韋濤仍削除自前所受官秩。」
entries.en: Their sons Dou Lusheng and Wei Tao were also stripped of former offices and ranks."
entries.literal: Dou Lusheng and Wei Tao are still to be stripped of all offices and ranks previously held."

entries.zh: 壬辰，以久雨，放百僚朝參，詔天下疏理係囚。
entries.en: On renchen prolonged rain canceled court; Mingzong ordered a realm-wide review of prisoners.
entries.literal: On renchen, because of prolonged rain, the hundred officials' court attendance was suspended, and an edict ordered the realm to review prisoners in custody.

entries.zh: 甲午，汴州奏，舊管曹州乞卻歸當道，從之。
entries.en: On jiawu Bian asked that Cao, formerly under it, return to the circuit, and Mingzong agreed.
entries.literal: On jiawu Bianzhou reported that Cao Prefecture, formerly under its jurisdiction, asked to return to its proper circuit, and it was approved.

entries.zh: 是日，詔曰：「承前使府奏請判官，率皆隨府除移停罷。
entries.en: That day an edict said: "Staff judges had once followed their governor out of office.
entries.literal: That day an edict said: "Under earlier practice, when military governors memorialized for staff judges, the judges were generally dismissed when the governor was transferred or removed.

entries.zh: 近年流例，有異前規，使府雖已除移，判官元安舊職。
entries.en: Lately judges had kept their posts after a governor moved.
entries.literal: In recent years the custom differed from the old rule: though the governor had been transferred, the judge still held his former post.

entries.zh: 起今後若是朝廷除授者，即不計使府除移，如是使府奏請，即皆隨府移罷。
entries.en: Court appointees would stay; governor-nominated judges would leave with the governor.
entries.literal: Hereafter, if the appointment came from the court, the governor's transfer shall not matter; if the governor memorialized for the appointment, the judge shall leave when the governor moves.

entries.zh: 舊例藩侯帶平章事者，所奏請判官，殿中已上許奏緋，中丞已上許奏紫，今不帶平章事亦許同帶平章事例處分。
entries.en: Formerly only acting grand councillors could nominate judges for scarlet or purple dress; now the same applied without that rank.
entries.literal: By old precedent, when a frontier lord held acting Grand Councillor rank, judges he memorialized for might wear scarlet from Palace Attendant up and purple from Vice Censor-in-Chief up; now even without acting Grand Councillor rank the same treatment is allowed.

entries.zh: 如防禦、團練使奏請判官，員外郎已下不在奏緋之限。
entries.en: Defense and training commissioners could not nominate judges below vice director for scarlet robes.
entries.literal: For defense and training commissioners memorializing for judges, those below Vice Director of a Bureau are not within the scarlet memorial limit.

entries.zh: 其所奏判官、州縣官，並須將曆任告身隨奏至京。
entries.en: Nominated judges and local officials had to file past patents with the memorial.
entries.literal: Judges and prefectural or county officials they memorialize for must all send past appointment patents with the memorial to the capital.

entries.zh: 如未有官，假稱試攝，亦奏狀內分明署出。
entries.en: Provisional acting posts had to be stated plainly in the memorial.
entries.literal: If they had no office yet but falsely claimed a provisional acting post, that too must be clearly stated in the memorial.

entries.zh: 如藩鎮留後、權知軍州事，並不在奏請判官之限。
entries.en: Regents and acting prefects could not nominate judges.
entries.literal: Acting military governors, regents, and those temporarily running a prefecture are not within the limit for memorializing judges.

entries.zh: 如刺史要奏州縣官，須申本道，請發表章，不得自奏。
entries.en: Prefects had to route county nominations through the circuit, not submit them directly.
entries.literal: If a prefect wished to memorialize for county officials, he had to report through his circuit and request a memorial from above, and might not memorialize on his own.

entries.zh: 近日州使奏請從事，本無官緒，妄結虛銜，不計職位高卑，多是請兼朱紫，不惟紊亂，實啟撓求。
entries.en: Lately prefectural envoys had invented titles and sought scarlet and purple for staff with no real rank, inviting corruption.
entries.literal: Recently prefectural envoys had memorialized for staff with no real office, inventing empty titles and, regardless of rank, mostly seeking concurrent scarlet and purple—not only disorderly but opening the door to importunity.

entries.zh: 宜令諸道州府，切準敕命處分。」
entries.en: Every circuit and prefecture was ordered to follow the edict."
entries.literal: Let every circuit and prefecture strictly follow this edict."

entries.zh: 秋七月乙巳，詔故偽蜀主王衍追封順正公，以諸侯禮葬。
entries.en: On yisi in the seventh month of autumn Mingzong posthumously enfeoffed late false-Shu ruler Wang Yan as Duke of Rectification with feudatory burial.
entries.literal: Autumn, seventh month, yisi: an edict posthumously enfeoffed the late false-Shu ruler Wang Yan as Duke of Rectification and buried him with feudatory rites.

entries.zh: 丙午，以前武信軍節度使李敬周為邠州節度使。
entries.en: On bingwu Li Jingzhou, former Wuxin commissioner, became Bin commissioner.
entries.literal: On bingwu former Wuxin army military commissioner Li Jingzhou was made Binzhou military commissioner.

entries.zh: 丁未，以滄州節度使安審通卒於師輟朝。
entries.en: On dingwei court mourned Cang commissioner An Shengtong's death on campaign.
entries.literal: On dingwei court was suspended for mourning because Cangzhou military commissioner An Shengtong died on campaign.

entries.zh: 壬子，以朔方節度使韓洙卒廢朝。
entries.en: On renzi court mourned Shuofang commissioner Han Zhu's death.
entries.literal: On renzi court was suspended for mourning because Shuofang military commissioner Han Zhu died.

entries.zh: 甲寅，王晏球奏，六月二十二日進攻逆城，將士傷者三千人。
entries.en: On jiayin Wang Yanqiu reported attacking the rebel city on the twenty-second of the sixth month with three thousand wounded.
entries.literal: On jiayin Wang Yanqiu reported that on the twenty-second of the sixth month he attacked the rebel city; three thousand officers and men were wounded.

entries.zh: 時晏球知城中有備，未欲急攻，朱宏昭、張虔釗切於立功，促攻賊壘，晏球不得已而進兵，遂致傷痍者眾。
entries.en: Yanqiu knew the city was ready and held back; Zhu Hongzhao and Zhang Qianzhao pressed for assault; forced to advance, he suffered heavy casualties.
entries.literal: At the time Yanqiu knew the city was prepared and did not wish to press the attack; Zhu Hongzhao and Zhang Qianzhao, eager for merit, urged assault on the rebel ramparts; Yanqiu advanced against his will and thus many were wounded.

entries.zh: 乙卯，以太子少保李茂勳卒輟朝。
entries.en: On yimao court mourned Crown Prince Junior Guardian Li Maoxun.
entries.literal: On yimao court was suspended for mourning because Crown Prince Junior Guardian Li Maoxun died.

entries.zh: 己未，詔弛曲禁，許民間自造，於秋苗上納征曲價，畝出五錢。
entries.en: On jiwei Mingzong relaxed the liquor monopoly, allowed private brewing, and levied five cash per mu on autumn grain.
entries.literal: On jiwei an edict relaxed the liquor monopoly and permitted private brewing; at autumn grain a monopoly tax of five cash per mu was to be paid.

entries.zh: 時孔循以曲法殺一家於洛陽，或獻此議，以為愛其人，便於國，故行之。
entries.en: Kong Xun had executed a Luoyang household under the liquor law; someone proposed sparing the people for the state's good—and the edict followed.
entries.literal: At the time Kong Xun had executed a household at Luoyang under the liquor law; someone offered this plan, holding that sparing the people would benefit the state—hence it was enacted.

entries.zh: 宗正卿李紓除名，刑部侍郎馬縞貶綏州司馬，刑部員外郎李慎儀貶階州司戶。
entries.en: Imperial Clan director Li Shu was struck from the rolls; Ma Gao, punishments vice minister, went to Suizhou aide; Li Shenyi, punishments outer official, to Jie registrar.
entries.literal: Director of the Imperial Clan Li Shu was removed from office; Vice Minister of Punishments Ma Gao was demoted to Suizhou aide; Punishments bureau outer official Li Shenyi was demoted to Jiezhou registrar.

entries.zh: 初，李紓差攝陵台令張保嗣等各虛稱試銜，為奉先令王延朗所訟，大理寺斷以詐假官論，刑部詳覆，稱非詐假。
entries.en: Li Shu had Zhang Baosi and other acting mausoleum officials falsely claim trial titles; Wang Yanlang of Fengxian sued; Judicial Review judged false appointment; Punishments on review denied it.
entries.literal: Initially Li Shu had acting Mausoleum Platform director Zhang Baosi and others falsely claim trial titles; Fengxian magistrate Wang Yanlang sued them; the Court of Judicial Review judged it false appointment; the Ministry of Punishments on review held it was not false appointment.

entries.zh: 大理執之，召兩司廷議，刑部理屈，故有是貶。
entries.en: Judicial Review held firm; both offices debated at court; Punishments lost—hence the demotions.
entries.literal: Judicial Review held to its judgment; both offices were summoned for court debate; Punishments lost—hence the demotions.

entries.zh: 紓續敕配隴州，徒一年。
entries.en: Shu was further assigned to Longzhou for one year's exile.
entries.literal: Shu was further by edict assigned to Longzhou and exiled one year.

entries.zh: 未幾，詔曰：「天下州府，例是攝官，皆結試銜，或因勘窮，便關詐假。
entries.en: Soon an edict said: "Prefectures and counties were acting officials who claimed trial titles, some proven false on investigation.
entries.literal: Before long an edict said: "Prefectures and counties everywhere are by rule acting officials, all claiming trial titles; some through investigation prove false.

entries.zh: 已前或有稱試銜，一切不問，此後並宜禁止。」
entries.en: Prior trial-title claims would not be pursued; hereafter they were forbidden."
entries.literal: If any before this claimed trial titles, all are not to be questioned; hereafter it is forbidden."

entries.zh: 曹州刺史成景宏貶綏州司戶參軍，續敕長流宥州，尋賜自盡，坐受本州倉吏錢百緡也。
entries.en: Caozhou prefect Cheng Jinghong was demoted to Su registrar, long-streamed to You, and ordered to kill himself for taking a hundred strings from granary clerks.
entries.literal: Caozhou prefect Cheng Jinghong was demoted to Suizhou registrar; by further edict he was long-streamed to Youzhou and soon ordered to kill himself—for taking one hundred strings from the prefectural granary clerks.

entries.zh: 壬戌，齊州防禦使曹廷隱以奏舉失實，配流永州，續敕賜自盡。
entries.en: On renxu Cao Tingyin of Qi, for false recommendation, was sent to Yong and ordered to kill himself.
entries.literal: On renxu Qizhou defense commissioner Cao Tingyin, for false memorial recommendation, was assigned to Yongzhou; by further edict he was ordered to kill himself.

entries.zh: 甲子，王晏球奏，今月十九日契丹七千騎來援定州，王師逆戰於唐河北，大破之。
entries.en: On jiazi Wang Yanqiu reported seven thousand Khitan relieving Ding on the nineteenth; the royal army routed them north of the Tang River.
entries.literal: On jiazi Wang Yanqiu reported that on the nineteenth of this month seven thousand Khitan horse came to relieve Ding; the royal army met them on the north of the Tang River and routed them.

entries.zh: 〈（案：《通鑒》：壬戌，王晏球破契丹於唐河。）〉
entries.en: (The 《Zizhi Tongjian》 says on renxu Wang Yanqiu routed the Khitan at the Tang River.)〉
entries.literal: (The 《Zizhi Tongjian》: On renxu Wang Yanqiu routed the Khitan at the Tang River.)〉

entries.zh: 追至滿城，又破之，斬二千級，獲馬千匹。
entries.en: Pursuing to Mancheng he routed them again, beheading two thousand and taking a thousand horses.
entries.literal: Pursuing to Mancheng he routed them again, beheaded two thousand, and captured a thousand horses.

entries.zh: 戊辰，詔福建節度使王延鈞可依前檢校太師、守中書令，進封閩王。
entries.en: On wuchen Wang Yanjun of Fujian kept grand preceptor and acting director and was advanced to Prince of Min.
entries.literal: On wuchen an edict ordered Fujian military commissioner Wang Yanjun to remain honorary Grand Preceptor and acting Secretariat Director and advanced him to Prince of Min.

entries.zh: 己巳，王晏球奏，此月二十一日，追契丹至易州，掩殺四十里，擒獲甚眾。
entries.en: On jisi Wang Yanqiu reported pursuing Khitan to Yi on the twenty-first and slaughtering them for forty li with many captured.
entries.literal: On jisi Wang Yanqiu reported that on the twenty-first of this month he pursued the Khitan to Yizhou and slaughtered them for forty li, capturing many.

entries.zh: 故朔方節度使韓洙贈太尉。
entries.en: Late Shuofang commissioner Han Zhu was posthumously made Grand Commandant.
entries.literal: The late Shuofang military commissioner Han Zhu was posthumously made Grand Commandant.

entries.zh: 以兵部侍郎王權、御史中丞梁文矩並為吏部侍郎，以左諫議大夫呂夢奇為御史中丞。
entries.en: Wang Quan of War and Liang Wenju, censor-in-chief, became personnel vice ministers; Lü Mengqi, Left Remonstrator, became censor-in-chief.
entries.literal: Vice Minister of War Wang Quan and Censor-in-Chief Liang Wenju were both made Vice Ministers of Personnel; Left Remonstrator Lü Mengqi was made Censor-in-Chief.

entries.zh: 天成三年春正月戊申朔，帝御崇元殿受朝賀，仗衛如式。
entries.en: On the wushen new moon of the first month of Tiancheng 3 Mingzong received New Year congratulations at the Chongyuan Hall with the usual guard.
entries.literal: In spring, first month of Tiancheng 3, on the wushen new moon the Emperor held audience at the Chongyuan Hall and received congratulations; guards and escort followed the usual rite.

entries.zh: 辛亥，前河陽節度使、檢校太傅、兼侍中孔以太子太師致仕。
entries.en: On xinhai Kong, former Heyang military commissioner, Grand Guardian by inspection, and concurrent Attendant-in-Chief, retired as grand preceptor to the heir apparent.
entries.literal: On xinhai, former Heyang military commissioner, Grand Guardian by inspection, and concurrent Attendant-in-Chief Kong was made Grand Preceptor emeritus.

entries.zh: 癸丑，詔取今月十七日幸鄴都。
entries.en: On guichou Mingzong ordered a visit to Ye capital on the seventeenth.
entries.literal: On guichou, an edict ordered that on the seventeenth of this month the Emperor should visit Ye capital.

entries.zh: 甲寅，以國子祭酒朱守素卒廢朝。
entries.en: On jiayin court was canceled for the death of national university director Zhu Shousu.
entries.literal: On jiayin, because Director of the National University Zhu Shousu had died, court attendance was suspended.

entries.zh: 丙辰，以鎮南軍節度使袁建豐卒廢朝，詔贈太尉。
entries.en: On bingchen court was canceled for Yuan Jianfeng of Zhennan and he was posthumously made grand marshal.
entries.literal: On bingchen, because Zhennan Army military commissioner Yuan Jianfeng had died, court was suspended; an edict posthumously gave Grand Marshal.

entries.zh: 丁巳，詔曰：「朕聞堯、舜有恤刑之典，貴務好生；
entries.en: On dingsi an edict said: "Yao and Shun's compassionate punishment and cherishing life;
entries.literal: On dingsi, an edict said: "We have heard that Yao and Shun had statutes of compassionate punishment, valuing the work of cherishing life;

entries.zh: 禹、湯申罪己之言，庶明知過。
entries.en: and Yu and Tang's confessions of fault so subjects might know their errors.
entries.literal: Yu and Tang voiced words of confessing faults, so the multitude might clearly know transgression.

entries.zh: 今月十七日，據巡檢軍使渾公兒口奏稱，有百姓二人，以竹竿習戰鬥之事。
entries.en: On the seventeenth Hun Gong'er reported two commoners practicing pole-fighting.
entries.literal: On the seventeenth of this month, according to a verbal memorial from patrol-inspection army commissioner Hun Gong'er, two commoners were practicing combat with bamboo poles.

entries.zh: 朕初聞奏報，實所不容，率爾傳宣，令付石敬瑭處置。
entries.en: Mingzong first ordered Shi Jingtang to punish them.
entries.literal: When We first heard the memorial We truly could not tolerate it and forthwith passed word ordering them given to Shi Jingtang for disposition.

entries.zh: 今旦重誨敷奏，方知悉是幼童為戲，載聆讜議，方覺失刑，循揣再三，愧惕非一。
entries.en: An Chonghui's morning report showed only children at play; Mingzong felt deeply ashamed of wrongful punishment.
entries.literal: This morning Chonghui presented the full report and We then learned it was entirely small children at play; hearing loyal remonstrance, We then realized wrongful punishment—weighed it again and again, shame and fear beyond counting.

entries.zh: 亦以渾公兒誑誣頗甚，石敬瑭詳覆稍乖，致人枉法而殂，處朕有過之地。
entries.en: Hun Gong'er had deceived him and Shi Jingtang's review had erred, putting innocent men to death and Mingzong at fault.
entries.literal: Also Hun Gong'er deceived and slandered to a great degree; Shi Jingtang's detailed review was slightly off, causing men to die by wrongful law and putting Us in a place of fault.

entries.zh: 今減常膳十日，以謝幽冤。
entries.en: He cut his meals ten days to atone for the dead.
entries.literal: Now We reduce Our regular meals ten days to apologize to the wronged shades.

entries.zh: 其石敬瑭是朕懿親，合施極諫，既茲錯誤，宜示省循，可罰一月俸。
entries.en: Shi Jingtang, as kin, should have remonstrated; he was fined one month's salary.
entries.literal: Shi Jingtang is Our close kin and ought to offer extreme remonstrance; since this error, he should be shown reflection and may be fined one month's salary.

entries.zh: 渾公兒決脊杖二十，仍銷在身職銜，配流登州。
entries.en: Hun Gong'er was given twenty strokes, stripped of rank, and exiled to Deng.
entries.literal: Hun Gong'er was sentenced to twenty strokes of the cudgel on the spine, his active office title still erased, and banished to Deng prefecture.

entries.zh: 小兒骨肉，賜絹五十匹、粟麥各百石，便令如法埋葬。
entries.en: Their families received fifty bolts of silk and one hundred piculs each of grain and wheat for lawful burial.
entries.literal: The children's kin were given fifty bolts of silk and one hundred piculs each of grain and wheat, and forthwith ordered buried according to law.

entries.zh: 兼此後在朝及諸道州府，凡有極刑，並須子細裁遣，不得因循。」
entries.en: Court and circuits were ordered to judge capital cases carefully, without lax precedent."
entries.literal: Moreover hereafter at court and in every circuit and prefecture, wherever there is extreme punishment, all must carefully decide and dispatch—there must be no lax following of precedent."

entries.zh: 百僚進表稱賀。
entries.en: Officials submitted congratulatory memorials.
entries.literal: The hundred officials submitted congratulatory memorials.

entries.zh: 五月己巳朔，帝御文明殿受朝。
entries.en: On the jisi new moon of the fifth month Mingzong held court at the Wenming Hall.
entries.literal: Fifth month, jisi new moon: the Emperor took the Wenming Hall to receive court.

entries.zh: 丙子，以夔州節度使西方鄴卒輟朝。
entries.en: On bingzi court was canceled for the death of Xi Fangye of Kuizhou.
entries.literal: On bingzi, court was suspended because Kuizhou military commissioner Xi Fangye had died.

entries.zh: 丁丑，大理卿李保殷卒。
entries.en: On dingchou judicial review director Li Baoyin died.
entries.literal: On dingchou, Director of the Court of Judicial Review Li Baoyin died.

entries.zh: 己卯，以忠武軍節度使索自通為京兆尹，充西京留守；
entries.en: On jimao Suo Zitong of Zhongwu became Jingzhao intendant and Western Capital regent;
entries.literal: On jimao, Zhongwu Army military commissioner Suo Zitong was made Jingzhao intendant, filling Western Capital regent;

entries.zh: 以左威衛上將軍朱漢賓為潞州節度使。
entries.en: Zhu Hanbin became Lu commissioner.
entries.literal: Left Majestic Guard senior general Zhu Hanbin was made Luzhou military commissioner.

entries.zh: 乙酉，以黔州節度使安崇阮為夔州節度使，以左驍衛上將軍張溫為洋州節度使，以黔州留後楊漢賓為本州節度使。
entries.en: On yiyou An Chongruan moved from Qian to Kuizhou, Zhang Wen became Yang commissioner, and Yang Hanbin full Qian commissioner.
entries.literal: On yiyou, Qian prefecture military commissioner An Chongruan was made Kuizhou military commissioner; Left Majestic Cavalry senior general Zhang Wen was made Yang prefecture military commissioner; Qian prefecture acting regent Yang Hanbin was made military commissioner of that prefecture.

entries.zh: 中書奏：「太常寺定少帝諡昭宣光烈孝皇帝，廟號景宗。
entries.en: The secretariat said: "The sacrifices court had set the Young Emperor's posthumous name Shaoxuan Guanglie Filial and temple name Jing.
entries.literal: The Secretariat memorialized: "The Court of Imperial Sacrifices has fixed the Young Emperor's posthumous title Emperor Shaoxuan Guanglie Filial, temple name Emperor Jing.

entries.zh: 伏以少帝今不入廟，難以言宗，隻雲昭宣光烈孝皇帝。」
entries.en: Since the Young Emperor was not in the temple, it asked to drop the temple name and use only Shaoxuan Guanglie Filial."
entries.literal: We submit that since the Young Emperor is not now entered in the temple, it is hard to speak of a temple name—only say Emperor Shaoxuan Guanglie Filial."

entries.zh: 從之。
entries.en: Approved.
entries.literal: It was approved.

entries.zh: 丁亥，以鳳州武興軍留後陳皋為武興軍節度使，以新州威塞軍留後翟璋為威塞軍節度使。
entries.en: On dinghai Chen Gao became Wuxing commissioner and Zhai Zhang Weisai commissioner.
entries.literal: On dinghai, Feng prefecture Wuxing Army acting regent Chen Gao was made Wuxing Army military commissioner; Xin prefecture Weisai Army acting regent Zhai Zhang was made Weisai Army military commissioner.

entries.zh: 壬辰，以權知尚書右丞崔居儉為尚書右丞。
entries.en: On renchen Cui Juyin moved from acting to full right secretariat vice director.
entries.literal: On renchen, acting Right Vice Director of the Secretariat Cui Juyin was made Right Vice Director of the Secretariat.

entries.zh: 詔葺天下廨宇。
entries.en: Mingzong ordered government offices repaired empire-wide.
entries.literal: An edict ordered repair of government offices throughout the realm.

entries.zh: 丙申，襄州奏，荊南高從誨乞歸順。
entries.en: On bingshen Xiang reported Gao Conghui of Jingnan sought submission.
entries.literal: On bingshen, Xiang prefecture memorialized that Jingnan Gao Conghui begged to submit.

entries.zh: 雲州奏，契丹犯塞。
entries.en: Yun reported Khitan border raids.
entries.literal: Yun prefecture memorialized that the Khitan violated the frontier.

entries.zh: 八月丁酉朔，大理正路阮奏：「切見春秋釋奠於文宣王，而武成王廟久曠時祭，請復常祀。」
entries.en: On dingyou in the eighth month Lu Ruan, grand court corrector, said: "Spring and autumn sacrifices reach Confucius, yet the Martial Completion King has long lacked regular rites; I ask that worship be restored."
entries.literal: Eighth month, dingyou: Grand Court Corrector Lu Ruan memorialized: "I observe that in spring and autumn the libation to Confucius is performed, yet the temple of the Martial Completion King has long lacked regular sacrifice; I ask that regular worship be restored."

entries.zh: 從之。
entries.en: Approved.
entries.literal: It was approved.

entries.zh: 戊戌，中書奏：「太子少傅李琪所撰進《霍彥威神道碑》文，不分真偽，是混功名，望令改撰。」
entries.en: On wuxu the Secretariat said: "Crown Prince Junior Tutor Li Qi's spirit-way stele for Huo Yanwei confounds true and false and merit and name; we ask that it be rewritten."
entries.literal: On wuxu the Central Secretariat memorialized: "The spirit-way stele text for Huo Yanwei submitted by Crown Prince Junior Tutor Li Qi does not distinguish true from false and confounds merit and name; we ask that it be rewritten."

entries.zh: 從之。
entries.en: Approved.
entries.literal: It was approved.

entries.zh: 琪，梁之故相，私懷感遇，敘彥威在梁曆任，不欲言偽梁故也。
entries.en: Qi had been a Liang chancellor who cherished old favor and, narrating Yanwei's Liang service, avoided naming false Liang—hence the fault.
entries.literal: Qi was a former Liang chancellor who privately cherished gratitude for favor and in narrating Yanwei's Liang service did not wish to speak of false Liang—hence this.

entries.zh: 辛丑，詔：「亂離已來，天下諸軍所掠生口，有主識認，即勒還之。」
entries.en: On xinchou an edict said: "Since the turmoil, captives taken by armies under Heaven, when owners can be identified, must be returned."
entries.literal: On xinchou an edict said: "Since the age of turmoil, among captives seized by armies under Heaven, where owners can be identified they are to be compelled to return them."

entries.zh: 以前清河縣令、襲酅國公、食邑三千戶楊仁矩為秘書丞。
entries.en: Yang Renju, former magistrate of Qinghe and Duke of E with three thousand fief households, became Secretariat aide.
entries.literal: Former Qinghe county magistrate Yang Renju, enfeoffed Duke of E with a fief of three thousand households, was made Secretariat aide.

entries.zh: 御史台奏：「主簿朱穎是前中丞奏請，合隨聽罷任。」
entries.en: The Censorate said: "Registrar Zhu Ying had been the former censor-in-chief's appointee and should leave when his patron did."
entries.literal: The Censorate memorialized: "Registrar Zhu Ying was requested by the former censor-in-chief and should leave office with his patron."

entries.zh: 詔曰：「主簿既為正秩，況入選門，顯自朝恩，合終考限，宜令仍舊守官。」
entries.en: An edict said: "The registrar already held regular rank and had entered by selection; the appointment was plainly from court and he should finish his term—let him remain."
entries.literal: An edict said: "The registrar already holds regular rank and moreover entered through the selection gate; the favor was plainly from court and he should complete his review term—let him remain in office."

entries.zh: 甲辰，以宰臣馮道為南郊大禮使，兵部尚書盧質為禮儀使，御史中丞許光義為儀仗使，兵部侍郎姚顗為鹵簿使，河南尹從榮為橋道頓遞使，客省使、衛尉卿張遵誨為修裝法物使。
entries.en: On jiachen Feng Dao became southern suburban chief ritualist; Lu Zhi of War, ritualist; Xu Guangyi, censor-in-chief, equipage master; Yao Yi of War, halberd master; Congrong of Henan, bridge and relay master; Zhang Zunhui, guest commissioner and Court of the Imperial Clan director, repair and regalia master.
entries.literal: On jiachen Chancellor Feng Dao was made southern suburban chief ritualist; Minister of War Lu Zhi ritualist; Censor-in-Chief Xu Guangyi equipage master; Vice Minister of War Yao Yan halberd master; Henan prefect Congrong bridge and relay master; Guest Bureau commissioner and Director of the Court for the Imperial Clan Zhang Zunhui repair and regalia master.

entries.zh: 乙巳，黑水朝貢使郭濟等率屬來朝，授歸德司戈，放還蕃。
entries.en: On yisi Guo Ji of Black River and others led their tribes to court, were made Returned Virtue company commanders, and were sent home.
entries.literal: On yisi Black River tribute envoy Guo Ji and others led their tribes to court; they were made Returned Virtue company commanders and sent back to their tribes.

entries.zh: 丁未，以翰林學士承旨、禮部侍郎、知制誥李愚為兵部侍郎，職如故。
entries.en: On dingwei Li Yu—Hanlin exequatur, vice minister of rites, and edict drafter—became vice minister of war at rank.
entries.literal: On dingwei Hanlin academician exequatur, Vice Minister of Rites, and edict drafter Li Yu was made Vice Minister of War at his post.

entries.zh: 以中書舍人盧詹為禮部侍郎，以兵部侍郎裴皞為太子賓客。
entries.en: Lu Zhan became vice minister of rites; Pei Hao of War became crown prince mentor.
entries.literal: Secretariat drafting officer Lu Zhan was made Vice Minister of Rites; Vice Minister of War Pei Hao was made crown prince mentor.

entries.zh: 吐渾首領念公山來朝貢。
entries.en: Tuyuhun chieftain Nian Gongshan presented tribute at court.
entries.literal: Tuyuhun chieftain Nian Gongshan came to court with tribute.

entries.zh: 戊申，帝服袞冕，禦文明殿，追冊昭宣光烈孝皇帝。
entries.en: On wushen Mingzong in full regalia held audience at the Hall of Civil Splendor to posthumously ennoble Emperor Zhaoxuan Guanglie Xiao.
entries.literal: On wushen the Emperor wore full regalia and held audience at the Hall of Civil Splendor to posthumously ennoble Emperor Zhaoxuan Guanglie Xiao.

entries.zh: 庚戌，以宰臣、監修國史趙鳳兼判集賢院事，以左散騎常侍任讚判大理卿事。
entries.en: On gengxu Zhao Feng—chancellor and supervising historiographer—also directed the Hall of Assembled Worthies; Ren Zan, left regular attendant, judged Court of Judicial Review affairs.
entries.literal: On gengxu Chancellor and supervising historiographer Zhao Feng was made concurrent Director of the Hall of Assembled Worthies; Left Regular Attendant Ren Zan judged Director of the Court of Judicial Review affairs.

entries.zh: 己未，高麗王王建遣使貢方物。
entries.en: On jiwei King Jian of Goryeo sent envoys with local tribute.
entries.literal: On jiwei King Jian of Goryeo sent envoys presenting local products.

entries.zh: 辛酉，詔：「準往例，節度使帶平章事、侍中、中書令，並列銜於敕牒，側書『使』字。
entries.en: An edict said: "By precedent, commissioners with concurrent grand councilor, palace attendant, or secretariat director titles listed them on edict slips with 'commissioner' written to the side.
entries.literal: An edict said: "By former precedent, military commissioners bearing concurrent Grand Councilor, Palace Attendant, or Secretariat Director titles all listed those titles on edict slips with the character 'commissioner' written to the side.

entries.zh: 今錢鏐是元帥、尚父，與使相名殊，馬殷守太師、尚書令，是南省官資，不合署敕尾，今後敕牒內並落下。」
entries.en: Qian Liu is marshal-in-chief and imperial father, unlike commissioners; Ma Yin holds grand preceptor and master of writing, a southern rank unfit for edict tails—hereafter omit both from edict slips."
entries.literal: Now Qian Liu is Marshal-in-Chief and Imperial Father, a title unlike commissioners; Ma Yin holds Grand Preceptor and Master of Writing, a southern-department rank unfit for signing edict tails—hereafter let both be omitted from edict slips."

entries.zh: 乙卯，党項首領朝貢。
entries.en: On yimao Tangut chieftains presented tribute.
entries.literal: On yimao Tangut chieftains presented tribute.

entries.zh: 甲子，幸金真觀，改賜建法大師，賜紫尼智願為圓惠大師，即武皇夫人陳氏也。
entries.en: On jiazi Mingzong visited Golden Truth Abbey, changed the bestowed title to Great Master Jianfa, and bestowed purple on the nun Zhiyuan as Great Master Yuanhui—Lady Chen, consort of Martial Emperor.
entries.literal: On jiazi the Emperor visited the Golden Truth Abbey, changed the bestowed title to Great Master Jianfa, and bestowed purple on the nun Zhiyuan as Great Master Yuanhui—she was Lady Chen, consort of Martial Emperor.

entries.zh: 丙寅，達靼來朝貢。
entries.en: On bingyin the Dadan presented tribute at court.
entries.literal: On bingyin the Dadan came to court with tribute.

entries.zh: 京城內有南州、北州，乃張全義光啟中所築。
entries.en: The capital held Southern and Northern wards that Zhang Quanyi had built in the Guangqi era.
entries.literal: Within the capital were Southern and Northern Wards, built by Zhang Quanyi in the Guangqi era.

entries.zh: 至是，詔許人依街巷請射城濠，任使平填，蓋造屋宇。
entries.en: An edict then allowed people to bid by ward and lane to fill the moat and build houses freely.
entries.literal: At this time an edict allowed people to bid by ward and lane to fill the moat and build houses as they wished.

entries.zh: 十一月丁卯，洛州水暴漲，壞居人垣舍。
entries.en: On dingmao in the eleventh month Lu waters rose violently and destroyed dwellings.
entries.literal: Eleventh month, dingmao: Luozhou waters rose violently and destroyed people's walls and houses.

entries.zh: 戊辰，以刑部侍郎張文寶為右散騎常侍。
entries.en: On wuchen Zhang Wenbao of Punishments became right regular attendant.
entries.literal: On wuchen Vice Minister of Punishments Zhang Wenbao was made Right Regular Attendant.

entries.zh: 己巳，以尚書右丞李光序為刑部侍郎。
entries.en: On jisi Li Guangxu, right vice director, became vice minister of punishments.
entries.literal: On jisi Right Vice Director Li Guangxu was made Vice Minister of Punishments.

entries.zh: 癸酉，升曹州濟陰縣為次赤，以昭宣光烈孝皇帝溫陵所在故也。
entries.en: On guiyou Jiyin of Cao was raised to second-tier red as the site of Emperor Zhaoxuan Guanglie Xiao's Warm Tomb.
entries.literal: On guiyou Jiyin county of Caozhou was raised to second-tier red because it was the site of Emperor Zhaoxuan Guanglie Xiao's Warm Tomb.

entries.zh: 甲戌，奉國軍節度使王延稟加兼侍中，從福建節度使王延鈞請也。
entries.en: On jiaxu Wang Yanbin of Fengguo gained concurrent palace attendant at Wang Yanjun of Fujian's request.
entries.literal: On jiaxu Fengguo Army military commissioner Wang Yanbin gained concurrent Palace Attendant at Fujian military commissioner Wang Yanjun's request.

entries.zh: 車駕出近郊，試夏州所進白鷹，戒左右勿令重誨知。
entries.en: Mingzong went to the near suburbs to fly Xia's white hawk, warning attendants to keep it from Chonghui.
entries.literal: The imperial carriage went to the near suburbs to try the white hawk Xia had presented, warning attendants not to let Chonghui know.

entries.zh: 己卯，日南至，帝御文明殿受朝賀。
entries.en: On jimao, the winter solstice, Mingzong held audience at the Hall of Civil Splendor for congratulation.
entries.literal: On jimao, the winter solstice, the Emperor held audience at the Hall of Civil Splendor to receive congratulation.

entries.zh: 癸未，秘書少監於嶠配振武長流百姓，永不齒任，為宰臣趙鳳誣奏也。
entries.en: On guiwei Yu Qiao, secretariat vice director, was sentenced to long exile as a commoner at Zhenwu and barred from office forever—Zhao Feng's false memorial.
entries.literal: On guiwei Secretariat vice director Yu Qiao was matched to a long-exiled commoner of Zhenwu and barred from office forever—Zhao Feng's false memorial.

entries.zh: 史官張昭遠等以新修獻祖、懿祖、太祖《紀年錄》共二十卷、《莊宗實錄》三十卷上之，賜器帛有差。
entries.en: Historiographers Zhang Zhaoyuan and others presented the new 《Chronicle Records》 of the exalted and illustrious and martial ancestors in twenty juan and the 《Veritable Record》 of Zhuangzong in thirty juan; vessels and silks were graded by rank.
entries.literal: Historiographers Zhang Zhaoyuan and others presented the newly compiled 《Chronicle Records》 of Exalted and Illustrious Ancestors and Martial Ancestor in twenty juan and the 《Veritable Record》 of Emperor Zhuangzong in thirty juan; vessels and silks were bestowed in graded amounts.

entries.zh: 〈（《五代會要》：監修趙鳳、修撰張昭遠、呂咸休各賜繒彩、銀器等。）〉
entries.en: (The 《Five Dynasties Essentials》 says supervising compiler Zhao Feng and compilers Zhang Zhaoyuan and Lü Xianxiu each received silks, silver vessels, and the like.)
entries.literal: (The 《Five Dynasties Essentials》: Supervising compiler Zhao Feng, compilers Zhang Zhaoyuan and Lü Xianxiu each received silks, silver vessels, and the like.)

entries.zh: 天成四年春正月壬申朔，帝御崇元殿受朝賀，仗衛如儀。
entries.en: On the renshen new moon of the first month of Tiancheng 4 Mingzong received New Year congratulations at the Chongyuan Hall with the usual guard.
entries.literal: In spring, first month of Tiancheng 4, on the renshen new moon the Emperor held audience at the Chongyuan Hall and received congratulations; guards and escort followed the usual rite.

entries.zh: 幽州節度使趙德鈞奏：「臣孫讚，年五歲，默念《論語》、《孝經》，舉童子，於汴州取解就試。」
entries.en: Zhao Dejun of Youzhou reported: "My grandson Zan, five years old, memorized the Analects and Classic of Filial Piety as a child candidate and sought to sit the qualifying exams at Bian."
entries.literal: Youzhou military commissioner Zhao Dejun memorialized: "Your servant's grandson Zan, five years old, recites from memory the Analects and Classic of Filial Piety, passed the child-candidate examination, and begs leave to take qualifying examinations at Bian."

entries.zh: 詔曰：「都尉之子，太尉之孫，能念儒書，備彰家訓，不勞就試，特與成名。
entries.en: The court replied: "As son of a commandant and grandson of a grand commandant, reciting Confucian classics and showing family teaching, he need not sit the exam—
entries.literal: An edict said: "Son of a commandant and grandson of a grand commandant, able to recite Confucian classics and clearly manifest family teaching, need not sit the examination—special passing is granted.

entries.zh: 宜賜別敕及第，附今年春榜。」
entries.en: grant a special patent and passing status, attached to this spring's list."
entries.literal: A special edict and passing grade are fitting, attached to this year's spring list."

entries.zh: 戊子，放元年應欠秋稅。
entries.en: On wuzi unpaid autumn taxes owed from the inaugural year were remitted.
entries.literal: On wuzi, unpaid autumn taxes due from the inaugural year were remitted.

entries.zh: 以左衛上將軍安崇阮為黔南節度使。
entries.en: Left Guard senior general An Chongruan became Qiannan commissioner.
entries.literal: Left Guard senior general An Chongruan was made Qiannan military commissioner.

entries.zh: 壬辰，回鶻入朝使掣撥等五人各授懷化司戈放還。
entries.en: On renchen Huihu court envoy Chebo and five others were each made Huaihua Company Commanders and sent home.
entries.literal: On renchen, Huihu court envoy Chebo and five others were each appointed Huaihua Company Commanders and sent home.

entries.zh: 以北京副留守馮贇為宣徽使、判三司。
entries.en: Beijing deputy regent Feng Yun became palace treasury commissioner and revenue overseer.
entries.literal: Beijing deputy regent Feng Yun was made Palace Treasury Commissioner and overseer of the Revenue Commission.

entries.zh: 戊戌，禁天下虛稱試攝銜。
entries.en: On wuxu false use of provisional appointment titles was forbidden throughout the realm.
entries.literal: On wuxu, false use throughout the realm of provisional appointment titles was forbidden.

entries.zh: 西川孟知祥奏：「支屬刺史乞臣本道自署。」
entries.en: Meng Zhixiang of Western Shu asked: "I beg that branch prefects be appointed by this circuit itself."
entries.literal: Meng Zhixiang of Western Shu memorialized: "I beg that branch prefects be appointed by this circuit itself."

entries.zh: 二月乙巳，王晏球奏，此月三日收復定州，獲王都首級，生擒契丹托諾等二千餘人。
entries.en: On yisi in the second month Wang Yanqiu reported recovering Ding on the third, taking Wang Du's head and capturing over two thousand Khitan including Tuonuo alive.
entries.literal: Second month, yisi: Wang Yanqiu memorialized that on the third of this month Ding prefecture had been recovered, Wang Du's head was taken, and more than two thousand Khitan including Tuonuo were captured alive.

entries.zh: 百僚稱賀已畢，乃詔取今月二十四日車駕還東京。
entries.en: After congratulations Mingzong ordered the court to return to the Eastern Capital on the twenty-fourth.
entries.literal: When the hundred officials' congratulations were finished, an edict then set the twenty-fourth of this month for the imperial carriage to return to the Eastern Capital.

entries.zh: 辛亥，以北面行營招討使、宋州節度使王晏球為鄆州節度使，加兼侍中；
entries.en: On xinhai Wang Yanqiu of Song became Yan commissioner with attendant-in-chief rank;
entries.literal: On xinhai, northern campaign headquarters commissioner and Song prefecture military commissioner Wang Yanqiu was made Yan prefecture military commissioner with added concurrent Attendant-in-Chief;

entries.zh: 以北面行營副招討使、滄州節度使李從敏為定州節度使；
entries.en: Li Congmin of Cang became Ding commissioner;
entries.literal: northern campaign deputy commissioner and Cang prefecture military commissioner Li Congmin was made Ding prefecture military commissioner;

entries.zh: 以北面行營兵馬都監、鄭州防禦使張虔釗為滄州節度使；
entries.en: and Zhang Qianzhao, northern campaign army supervisor and defense commissioner of Zhengzhou, became military governor of Cangzhou;
entries.literal: northern campaign horse-army commander-in-chief and Zhengzhou defense commissioner Zhang Qianzhao was made Cang prefecture military commissioner;

entries.zh: 幽州節度使趙德鈞加兼侍中。
entries.en: Zhao Dejun of Youzhou received attendant-in-chief rank.
entries.literal: Youzhou military commissioner Zhao Dejun was given added concurrent Attendant-in-Chief.

entries.zh: 乙卯，以樞密使趙敬怡權知汴州軍州事。
entries.en: On yimao Zhao Jingyi acted as regent at Bian.
entries.literal: On yimao, Privy Commissioner Zhao Jingyi was ordered to act as regent of Bian prefecture military headquarters.

entries.zh: 丙辰，邢州奏，定州送到偽太子李繼陶，已處置訖。
entries.en: On bingchen Xing reported the false heir Li Jitao from Ding had been executed.
entries.literal: On bingchen, Xing prefecture memorialized that the false heir Li Jitao sent from Ding had been disposed of.

entries.zh: 辛酉，帝御咸安樓受定州俘馘，百官就列，宣露布於樓前，禮畢，以王都首級獻於太社。
entries.en: On xinyou Mingzong at the Xian'an Tower received Ding captives, proclaimed the victory bulletin, and offered Wang Du's head at the Grand Shrine.
entries.literal: On xinyou, the Emperor took the Xian'an Tower to receive Ding captives and heads; the hundred officials took their places; the victory bulletin was proclaimed before the tower; when the rite was finished, Wang Du's head was offered at the Grand Shrine of State.

entries.zh: 王都男四人、弟一人，禿餒父子二人，並磔於市。
entries.en: Wang Du's four sons and brother and the Tu Nei father and son were dismembered in the market.
entries.literal: Wang Du's four sons, one younger brother, and the father-and-son pair Tu Nei were all dismembered in the market.

entries.zh: 〈（《五代會要》：尚書兵部宣露布於樓前，宣訖，尚書刑部侍郎張文寶奏曰：「逆賊王都首級請付所司。」
entries.en: (The 《Five Dynasties Essentials》 says War at the Secretariat proclaimed the bulletin at the tower; when it ended Zhang Wenbao of Punishments asked that Wang Du's head be given to the proper office."
entries.literal: (The 《Five Dynasties Essentials》: The Ministry of War of the Secretariat proclaimed the victory bulletin before the tower; when the proclamation ended, Vice Director of the Ministry of Punishments Zhang Wenbao memorialized: "The rebel Wang Du's head is requested to be delivered to the relevant office."

entries.zh: 大理卿蕭希甫受之以出，獻於郊社，其王都男並蕃將等磔於開封橋。）〉
entries.en: Judicial review director Xiao Xifu took it out and offered it at the suburban altars; Wang Du's sons and Tangut generals were dismembered at Kaifeng Bridge.)〉
entries.literal: Director of the Court of Judicial Review Xiao Xifu received it and went out, offered it at the suburban altars, and Wang Du's sons and the Tangut generals were dismembered at Kaifeng Bridge.)〉

entries.zh: 時露布之文，類制敕之體，蓋執筆者誤，頗為識者所嗤。
entries.en: The bulletin read like an edict, a scribe's mistake that critics mocked.
entries.literal: At the time the victory bulletin's text resembled the style of an edict—probably the scribe's error—and was much ridiculed by the knowing.

entries.zh: 樞密使趙敬怡卒，贈太傅。
entries.en: Zhao Jingyi died and was posthumously made grand mentor.
entries.literal: Privy Commissioner Zhao Jingyi died and was posthumously given Grand Mentor.

entries.zh: 以端明殿學士趙鳳權知汴州軍州事。
entries.en: Zhao Feng acted as regent at Bian.
entries.literal: Duanming Hall academician Zhao Feng was ordered to act as regent of Bian prefecture military headquarters.

entries.zh: 甲子，車駕發汴州。
entries.en: On jiazi Mingzong left Bian.
entries.literal: On jiazi, the imperial carriage departed Bian prefecture.

entries.zh: 丙寅，至鄭州。
entries.en: On bingyin he reached Zheng.
entries.literal: On bingyin, he reached Zheng prefecture.

entries.zh: 賜左僕射致仕鄭玨錢二十萬。
entries.en: Retired left vice director Zheng Jue received two hundred thousand cash.
entries.literal: Retired Left Vice Director Zheng Jue was granted two hundred thousand in cash.

entries.zh: 丁卯，宰相崔協卒，詔贈尚書右僕射。
entries.en: On dingmao Cui Xie died and was posthumously made right vice director.
entries.literal: On dingmao, Chancellor Cui Xie died; an edict posthumously gave Right Vice Director.

entries.zh: 東都留守、太子少傅李琪等奉，至偃師縣奉迎。
entries.en: Li Qi, Eastern Capital regent and crown prince junior tutor, welcomed him at Yanshi.
entries.literal: Eastern Capital regent and Crown Prince Junior Tutor Li Qi and others came out to welcome him at Yanshi county.

entries.zh: 時琪奏章中有「敗契丹之凶黨，破真定之逆城」之言。
entries.en: Li Qi's welcome memorial called the Khitan a "villain faction" and Zhending a "rebel city."
entries.literal: At the time Qi's memorial had the words "defeated the Khitan villain faction" and "broke the rebel city of Zhending."

entries.zh: 詔曰：「契丹即為凶黨，真定不是逆城，李琪罰一月俸。」
entries.en: Mingzong fined Li Qi one month's salary for calling the Khitan villains and Zhending a rebel city."
entries.literal: An edict said: "If the Khitan are already a villain faction, Zhending is not a rebel city—Li Qi is fined one month's salary."

entries.zh: 庚午，車駕至自汴州。
entries.en: On gengwu Mingzong arrived from Bian.
entries.literal: On gengwu, the imperial carriage arrived from Bian prefecture.

entries.zh: 長興元年春正月丙寅朔，帝御明堂殿受朝賀，仗衛如常儀。
entries.en: On the bingyin new moon of the first month in spring of Changxing 1 Mingzong received New Year congratulations at the Bright Hall with the usual ceremonial guard.
entries.literal: In the first year of Changxing, spring, first month, bingyin new moon: the Emperor took the Bright Hall to receive court congratulations; guards and retinue were as usual.

entries.zh: 乙亥，國子監請以監學生束修及光學錢備監中修葺公用，從之。
entries.en: On yihai the Imperial Academy asked to use student presentation fees and Guangxue funds for institute repairs. Approved.
entries.literal: On yihai the Directorate of Education requested that supervisory students' presentation gifts and Guangxue fees be used for repairs and public expenses within the directorate. It was approved.

entries.zh: 丙子，帝謂宰臣曰：「時雪未降，如何？」
entries.en: On bingzi Mingzong asked the chancellors: "Snow has not yet fallen—what of it?"
entries.literal: On bingzi the Emperor said to the chancellors: "Snow has not yet fallen—what of it?"

entries.zh: 馮道曰：「陛下恭行儉德，憂及蒸民，上合天心，必有春澤。」
entries.en: Feng Dao said: "Your Majesty practices frugal virtue and cares for the people—that accords with Heaven, and spring rains will surely come."
entries.literal: Feng Dao said: "Your Majesty practices frugal virtue and cares for the common people—this accords with Heaven's heart; spring moisture will surely come."

entries.zh: 是夜，降雪。
entries.en: That night snow fell.
entries.literal: That night snow fell.

entries.zh: 其夕，右散騎常侍蕭希甫封狀申樞密稱，得河堰衙官狀，告本都將校二十餘人欲謀不軌，至旦追問無狀，斬所告人。
entries.en: That evening right regular cavalier Xiao Xifu sent a sealed report to the military secretariat saying a river-dike yamen officer had accused more than twenty local officers of plotting rebellion; by dawn no evidence was found and the accuser was executed.
entries.literal: That evening Right Regular Cavalier Xiao Xifu submitted a sealed memorial to the Military Secretariat reporting that he had received a petition from a river-dike yamen officer accusing more than twenty local commanders and officers of plotting sedition; by dawn interrogation found no evidence, and the accuser was executed.

entries.zh: 是日，幸至德宮。
entries.en: That day Mingzong visited the Palace of Utmost Virtue.
entries.literal: That day he visited the Palace of Utmost Virtue.

entries.zh: 辛卯，中書奏，郊天有日，合差大內留守。
entries.en: On xinmao the secretariat reported that the suburban sacrifice to Heaven had been scheduled and a grand inner custodian should be appointed.
entries.literal: On xinmao the Secretariat memorialized that the suburban sacrifice to Heaven had a set date and a Grand Inner Custodian should be appointed.

entries.zh: 詔以宣徽南院使朱宏昭充。
entries.en: Zhu Hongzhao, palace secretariat southern commissioner, was appointed to fill the post.
entries.literal: An edict appointed Zhu Hongzhao, commissioner of the southern bureau of the Palace Secretariat, to the post.

entries.zh: 二月戊戌，幸稻田莊。
entries.en: On wuxu in the second month Mingzong visited the Rice Field Estate.
entries.literal: Second month, wuxu: the Emperor visited the Rice Field Estate.

entries.zh: 己亥，黑水國主兀兒遣使貢方物。
entries.en: On jihai the Heishui ruler Wu'er sent tribute envoys with local products.
entries.literal: On jihai, the lord of the Heishui state Wu'er sent envoys presenting local products.

entries.zh: 翰林學士劉煦奏：「新學士入院，舊試五題，請今後停試詩賦，隻試麻製、答蕃書、批答共三道。
entries.en: Hanlin academician Liu Xu memorialized: "New fellows should drop poetry and rhapsody from the five-topic entrance exam and test only edict drafts, foreign letters, and rescripts.
entries.literal: Hanlin academician Liu Xu memorialized: "When new academicians enter the institute, the old test had five topics; it is requested that hereafter poetry and rhapsody be stopped, and only three topics be tested—draft edicts, replies to foreign letters, and rescripts in all.

entries.zh: 仍請內賜題目，定字數，付本院召試。」
entries.en: He also wanted court-set topics and word limits and tests summoned by the Hanlin Institute."
entries.literal: It is further requested that topics be granted from within, word counts fixed, and the institute be charged to summon the test."

entries.zh: 從之。
entries.en: Approved.
entries.literal: It was approved.

entries.zh: 〈（《五代會要》載劉煦原奏云：「舊例學士入院，除中書舍人不試，餘官皆先試麻製、答蕃、批答各一道，詩賦各一道，號曰五題，並於當日呈納。
entries.en: (The 《Five Dynasties Essentials》 quotes Liu Xu: "Entrants except Secretariat drafters faced five same-day topics—edict drafts, foreign replies, rescripts, poetry, and rhapsody.
entries.literal: (The 《Five Dynasties Essentials》 records Liu Xu's original memorial saying: "By old rule when academicians enter the institute, except for Secretariat drafters who are not tested, all other offices are first tested on one topic each of draft edicts, replies to foreigners, and rescripts, and one topic each of poetry and rhapsody, called the five topics, all to be submitted the same day.

entries.zh: 從前每遇召試，多預出五題，潛令宿構，其無黨援者，即日起草，罕能成功。
entries.en: Leaked topics let favorites prepare overnight while outsiders drafted on the spot and rarely passed.
entries.literal: Whenever a summoned test occurred in the past, the five topics were often leaked in advance and candidates secretly made to prepare overnight; those without factional backing had to draft on the spot and rarely succeeded.

entries.zh: 今請權停詩賦，隻試三道，仍內賜題目，兼定字數。」
entries.en: He asked to drop poetry and rhapsody, test only the three prose topics, and keep court-set limits."
entries.literal: Now it is requested to suspend poetry and rhapsody for the time being and test only the three topics, still with topics granted from within and word counts fixed."

entries.zh: 從之。）〉
entries.en: Approved.)〉
entries.literal: It was approved.)〉

entries.zh: 有司奏：「皇帝致齋於明堂，按舊服通天冠、絳紗袍，文武五品已上著袴褶，近例隻著朝服。」
entries.en: Offices memorialized: "For Mingtang fasting, the emperor should wear the Tongtian crown and crimson robe and fifth-rank officials trousers and jackets, not only court dress as in recent practice."
entries.literal: The relevant offices memorialized: "When the Emperor performs fasting at the Bright Hall, by old custom he wears the Tongtian crown and crimson gauze robe, and civil and military officials of fifth rank and above wear trousers and jackets; in recent practice only court dress is worn."

entries.zh: 從之。
entries.en: Approved.
entries.literal: It was approved.

entries.zh: 乙巳，中書奏：「皇帝朝獻太微宮、太廟，祭天地於圜丘，準禮例親王為亞獻行事，受誓戒。」
entries.en: On yisi the secretariat memorialized: "When the emperor offers at the Supreme Palace, Grand Shrine, and Round Mound, princes should serve as secondary offerers and take the abstention oath."
entries.literal: On yisi, the Secretariat memorialized: "When the Emperor offers at the Supreme Palace of the Purple Subtlety and the Grand Shrine, and sacrifices to Heaven and Earth at the Round Mound, by ritual precedent imperial princes serve as secondary offerers, perform the rites, and receive the abstention oath."

entries.zh: 從之。
entries.en: Approved.
entries.literal: It was approved.

entries.zh: 以天雄軍節度使石敬瑭為御營使。
entries.en: Shi Jingtang of Tianxiong became imperial camp commissioner.
entries.literal: Tianxiong army military commissioner Shi Jingtang was made imperial camp commissioner.

entries.zh: 壬子，帝宿齋於明堂殿。
entries.en: On renzi Mingzong fasted at the Bright Hall.
entries.literal: On renzi, the Emperor lodged in fasting at the Bright Hall.

entries.zh: 癸丑，朝獻太微宮。
entries.en: On guichou he offered at the Supreme Palace.
entries.literal: On guichou, he offered at the Supreme Palace of the Purple Subtlety.

entries.zh: 是日，宿齋於太廟。
entries.en: That day he fasted at the Grand Shrine.
entries.literal: That day he lodged in fasting at the Grand Shrine.

entries.zh: 詰旦，請行饗禮。
entries.en: At dawn he began the feast rite.
entries.literal: At dawn he requested to perform the feast rite.

entries.zh: 甲寅，赴南郊齋宮。
entries.en: On jiayin he entered the southern suburb fasting palace.
entries.literal: On jiayin, he went to the southern suburb fasting palace.

entries.zh: 是夜微雨，三鼓後晴明如晝。
entries.en: Light rain fell that night, then after the third watch the sky cleared bright as day.
entries.literal: That night there was light rain; after the third watch it cleared bright as day.

entries.zh: 乙卯，祀昊天上帝於圜丘，柴燎禮畢，郊宮受賀。
entries.en: On yimao he sacrificed to Heaven at the Round Mound, and after the firewood offering the suburban palace received congratulations.
entries.literal: On yimao, he sacrificed to the Supreme Lord of Heaven at the Round Mound; when the firewood offering was finished, congratulations were received at the suburban palace.

entries.zh: 是日，禦五鳳樓，宣製：改天成五年為長興元年；
entries.en: That day at the Five Phoenix Tower he proclaimed the era change from Tiancheng 5 to Changxing 1;
entries.literal: That day he took the Five Phoenix Tower and proclaimed a rescript: the fifth year of Tiancheng is changed to the first year of Changxing;

entries.zh: 大赦天下，除十惡五逆、放火劫舍、屠牛、官典犯贓、偽行印信、合造毒藥外，罪無輕重，咸赦除之。
entries.en: and a great amnesty excepting the ten abominations, five rebellions, arson, robbery, cattle slaughter, official corruption, forged seals, and poison-making.
entries.literal: a great amnesty for the realm, excepting the ten abominations and five rebellions, arson and robbery, slaughtering cattle, official corruption, forging seals, and compounding poison—all crimes light or heavy are pardoned.

entries.zh: 天成四年終諸道所欠殘稅及場院欠折，並特放免。
entries.en: Residual taxes and market debts from Tiancheng 4 were remitted in every circuit.
entries.literal: Outstanding residual taxes and market shortfalls owed by every circuit at the end of Tiancheng 4 were specially remitted.

entries.zh: 群臣職位帶平章事、侍中、中書令，並與改鄉名裏號。
entries.en: Grand councillors, attendants-in-chief, and secretariat directors received new native place names.
entries.literal: Ministers whose posts carried Grand Councillor, Attendant-in-Chief, or Secretariat Director were all given changed native district and lane names.

entries.zh: 朝臣及蕃侯郡守亡父母，及父母在並妻室未沾恩命者，並與恩澤。
entries.en: Officials and tribal governors with deceased parents or living parents and unfavored wives received amnesty favors.
entries.literal: Court officials and tribal frontier governors whose parents had died, or whose parents were alive together with wives not yet favored by grace, were all granted favor.

entries.zh: 應私債出利已經倍者，隻許征本；
entries.en: Private debts whose interest had doubled principal could collect only principal;
entries.literal: On private debts whose interest had already doubled the principal, only the principal may be collected;

entries.zh: 已經兩倍者，本利並放。
entries.en: where interest reached twice the principal, both were forgiven.
entries.literal: where interest had already reached twice the principal, both principal and interest are remitted.

entries.zh: 河陽管內人戶，每畝舊征橋道錢五文，今後不征。
entries.en: Heyang's old five-cash-per-mu bridge levy was abolished.
entries.literal: For households within Heyang circuit, the old bridge and road levy of five cash per mu is hereafter not collected.

entries.zh: 諸道州府每畝先征曲錢五文，今特放二文雲。
entries.en: Every circuit prefecture's five-cash yeast levy per mu was cut by two cash.
entries.literal: For every prefecture in every circuit the former levy of five cash per mu in yeast fees is specially reduced by two cash.

entries.zh: 商州吏民以刺史郭知瓊善政聞，詔褒之。
entries.en: Shang reported prefect Guo Zhiqiong's good rule and Mingzong praised him.
entries.literal: Shang prefecture officials and people reported that prefect Guo Zhiqiong's good government was heard of; an edict praised him.

entries.zh: 九月乙丑，階州刺史王宏贄上言：「一州主客戶才及千戶，並無縣局，臣今檢括得新舊主客已及三千二百，欲依舊額立將利、福津二縣，請置令佐。」
entries.en: On yichou in the ninth month Wang Hongzan of Jie said the prefecture had barely a thousand households and no counties; he tallied three thousand two hundred and asked to restore Jiangli and Fujin counties with magistrates.
entries.literal: Ninth month, yichou: Jie prefecture prefect Wang Hongzan memorialized: "This prefecture has barely a thousand main and guest households and no county offices; I have now tallied old and new main and guest households at three thousand two hundred and wish to establish the two counties Jiangli and Fujin by the old quota and request magistrates and aides."

entries.zh: 從之。
entries.en: Approved.
entries.literal: It was approved.

entries.zh: 丁丑，詔天下諸州府，不得奏薦著紫衣官員為州縣官。
entries.en: On dingchou Mingzong forbade recommending purple-robed officials for prefectural and county posts.
entries.literal: On dingchou an edict said that throughout the realm prefectures and circuits might not recommend officials wearing purple for prefectural and county posts.

entries.zh: 戊寅，升尚書右丞為正四品。
entries.en: On wuyin the right secretariat director was raised to regular fourth rank.
entries.literal: On wuyin, Right Secretariat director was raised to regular fourth rank.

entries.zh: 癸未，利、閬、遂三州奏，東川節度使董璋謀叛，結連西川孟知祥。
entries.en: On guiwei Li, Lang, and Su reported Dongchuan commissioner Dong Zhang plotting rebellion with Xichuan Meng Zhixiang.
entries.literal: On guiwei, Li, Lang, and Su prefectures memorialized that Dongchuan military commissioner Dong Zhang plotted rebellion and allied with Xichuan Meng Zhixiang.

entries.zh: 甲申，以鎮州節度使範延光為檢校太傅、守刑部尚書，充樞密使。
entries.en: On jiashen Fan Yanguang of Zhen became honorary grand preceptor, punishments minister, and privy commissioner.
entries.literal: On jiashen, Zhenzhou military commissioner Fan Yanguang was made honorary Grand Preceptor, Minister of Punishments, and Privy Commissioner.

entries.zh: 利州、閬州進納東川檄書，言將兵擊利、閬，責以間諜朝廷為名。
entries.en: Li and Lang forwarded Dongchuan proclamations threatening attack and charging court espionage.
entries.literal: Li and Lang prefectures forwarded Dongchuan proclamations saying they would attack Li and Lang, charging espionage against the court.

entries.zh: 乙酉，以左驍衛上將軍趙在禮為同州節度使兼四面行營馬步軍都指揮使。
entries.en: On yiyou Zhao Zaili became Tong commissioner and four-fronts field army commander.
entries.literal: On yiyou, Left Bold Cavalry senior general Zhao Zaili was made Tongzhou military commissioner and concurrent commander-in-chief of the Four Fronts field army horse and foot.

entries.zh: 樞密院直學士、守工部侍郎閻至，樞密院直學士、守尚書右丞史圭，並轉戶部侍郎，依前充職。
entries.en: Yan Zhi and Shi Gui—privy regular academics—became vice revenue ministers at rank.
entries.literal: Privy Council regular academician and acting Vice Minister of Works Yan Zhi, and Privy Council regular academician and acting Right Secretariat director Shi Gui, were both transferred to Vice Minister of Revenue, continuing at their posts.

entries.zh: 以翰林學士、守戶部侍郎李懌為尚書右丞；
entries.en: Li Yi became right secretariat director;
entries.literal: Hanlin academician and acting Vice Minister of Revenue Li Yi was made Right Secretariat director;

entries.zh: 以翰林學士、戶部侍郎劉煦為兵部侍郎；
entries.en: Liu Xu became vice war minister;
entries.literal: Hanlin academician and Vice Minister of Revenue Liu Xu was made Vice Minister of War;

entries.zh: 以翰林學士、中書舍人竇夢征為工部侍郎，依前充職。
entries.en: Dou Mengzheng became vice works minister at rank.
entries.literal: Hanlin academician and Secretariat aide Dou Mengzheng was made Vice Minister of Works, continuing at his post.

entries.zh: 以中書舍人劉讚為御史中丞，以御史中丞許光義為兵部侍即，以兵部侍郎姚顗為吏部侍郎。
entries.en: Liu Zan became censor-in-chief; Xu Guangyi became vice war minister; Yao Yi became vice personnel minister.
entries.literal: Secretariat aide Liu Zan was made Censor-in-chief; Censor-in-chief Xu Guangyi was made Vice Minister of War; Vice Minister of War Yao Yi was made Vice Minister of Personnel.

entries.zh: 丙戌，詔東川節度使董璋可削奪在身官爵，仍征兵進討。
entries.en: On bingxu Mingzong stripped Dong Zhang's ranks and ordered troops to attack.
entries.literal: On bingxu an edict said Dongchuan military commissioner Dong Zhang's current ranks and titles might be stripped and troops raised to attack.

entries.zh: 丁亥，以西川節度使孟知祥兼西南面供饋使，天雄軍節度使石敬瑭兼東川行營都招討使，以遂州節度使夏魯奇兼東川行營招討副使。
entries.en: On dinghai Meng Zhixiang became southwest supply commissioner; Shi Jingtang became Dongchuan campaign commander; Xia Luqi became deputy.
entries.literal: On dinghai, Xichuan military commissioner Meng Zhixiang was made concurrent southwest supply commissioner; Tianxiong military commissioner Shi Jingtang was made concurrent Dongchuan campaign commander-in-chief; Suizhou military commissioner Xia Luqi was made concurrent Dongchuan campaign deputy commander.

entries.zh: 庚寅，以右衛上將軍王思同為京兆尹，充西京留守兼西南行營馬步都虞候。
entries.en: On gengyin Wang Sitong became Jingzhao prefect, Luoyang regent, and southwest campaign deputy.
entries.literal: On gengyin, Right Guard senior general Wang Sitong was made Jingzhao prefect, Western Capital regent, and southwest campaign horse-and-foot deputy commander.

entries.zh: 十一月庚申朔，帝御文明殿，冊皇子秦王，仗衛樂懸如儀。
entries.en: On the gengshen new moon of the eleventh month Mingzong at the Hall of Civil Splendor invested Prince Qin; guards and suspended music followed ritual.
entries.literal: Eleventh month, gengshen new moon: the Emperor held audience at the Hall of Civil Splendor to invest Prince Qin; guards and the suspended ritual-music instruments followed the prescribed ceremony.

entries.zh: 甲子，正衙命使冊皇子宋王於鎮州。
entries.en: On jiazi envoys at the main court invested Prince Song at Zhen.
entries.literal: On jiazi envoys appointed at the main court invested Prince Song at Zhen prefecture.

entries.zh: 是日，幸龍門。
entries.en: That day he visited Longmen.
entries.literal: That day he visited Longmen.

entries.zh: 翌日，馮道奏曰：「陛下宮中無事，遊幸近郊則可矣，若涉曆山險，萬一馬足蹉跌，則貽臣下之憂。
entries.en: Next day Feng Dao said: "When the palace is quiet, touring nearby suburbs suffices; if you cross Li Mountain's peril and a horse stumbles, you will trouble your ministers.
entries.literal: The next day Feng Dao memorialized: "When nothing presses at palace, touring the nearby suburbs suffices; if Your Majesty crosses Li Mountain's peril, should a horse stumble, you would trouble your ministers.

entries.zh: 臣聞千金之子，坐不垂堂；
entries.en: I have heard the son of a thousand gold does not sit under eaves;
entries.literal: I have heard that the son of a thousand gold does not sit with eaves overhead;

entries.zh: 百金之子，立不倚衡。
entries.en: the son of a hundred gold does not stand leaning on a railing.
entries.literal: the son of a hundred gold does not stand leaning on a railing.

entries.zh: 況貴為天子，豈可自輕哉！」
entries.en: How much more the Son of Heaven—how can he make light of himself!"
entries.literal: How much more one exalted as Son of Heaven—how can he make light of himself!"

entries.zh: 帝斂容謝之。
entries.en: Mingzong composed himself and thanked him.
entries.literal: The Emperor composed himself and thanked him.

entries.zh: 退令小黃門至中書問道垂堂、倚衡之義，道因注解以聞，帝深納之。
entries.en: He retired and sent a junior yellow gate to the Secretariat to ask the meaning of not sitting under eaves and not leaning on a railing; Dao explained and reported; Mingzong deeply accepted it.
entries.literal: He retired and sent a junior yellow gate to the Secretariat to ask the meaning of "not sitting under eaves" and "not leaning on a railing"; Dao explained and reported; the Emperor deeply accepted it.

entries.zh: 己巳，故太子少保致仕封舜卿贈太子少傅。
entries.en: On jisi the late retired Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent Feng Shunqing was posthumously made Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent.
entries.literal: On jisi the late retired Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent Feng Shunqing was posthumously made Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent.

entries.zh: 庚午，應州節度使張敬達移雲州，以捧聖都指揮使、守恩州刺史沙彥詢為應州節度使；
entries.en: On gengwu Zhang Jingda, military governor of Yingzhou, was transferred to Yunzhou; Sha Yanxun, Pingsheng overall commander and acting prefect of Enzhou, became military governor of Yingzhou;
entries.literal: On gengwu Ying military commissioner Zhang Jingda was transferred to Yun; Protector Saint commander and En prefect Sha Yanxun was made Ying military commissioner;

entries.zh: 以潁州團練使高行周為安北都護，充振武節度使。
entries.en: Gao Xingzhou, Yingzhou training commissioner, became Protector-General of Pacifying the North and Zhenwu commissioner.
entries.literal: Yingzhou training commissioner Gao Xingzhou was made Protector-General of Pacifying the North and Zhenwu military commissioner.

entries.zh: 壬申，黔南節度使楊漢章棄城奔忠州，為董璋所攻也。
entries.en: On renshen Yang Hanzhang of Qiannan abandoned his post and fled to Zhong—attacked by Dong Zhang.
entries.literal: On renshen Qiannan military commissioner Yang Hanzhang abandoned his post and fled to Zhong—attacked by Dong Zhang.

entries.zh: 乙亥，製西川節度使孟知祥削奪官爵，以其同董璋叛也。
entries.en: On yihai an order stripped Xichuan commissioner Meng Zhixiang of rank for colluding with Dong Zhang.
entries.literal: On yihai an order stripped Xichuan military commissioner Meng Zhixiang of rank for colluding with Dong Zhang in rebellion.

entries.zh: 丙子，以前同州節度使羅周敬為左監門上將軍。
entries.en: On bingzi former Tong commissioner Luo Zhoujing became General of the Left Palace Gate Guard.
entries.literal: On bingzi former Tongzhou military commissioner Luo Zhoujing was made Left Gate of Surveillance general.

entries.zh: 丁丑，故兵部侍郎許光義加贈禮部尚書。
entries.en: On dingchou the late Vice Minister of War Xu Guangyi was further posthumously made Minister of Rites.
entries.literal: On dingchou the late Vice Minister of War Xu Guangyi was further posthumously made Minister of Rites.

entries.zh: 辛巳，西面軍前奏，今月十三日，階州刺史王宏贄、瀘州刺史馮暉，自利州取山路出劍門關外倒下，殺敗董璋守關兵士三千餘人，收復劍州。
entries.en: On xinsi the western front reported: on the thirteenth Jie prefect Wang Hongzan and Lu prefect Feng Hui, from Li by a mountain path outside Jianmen Pass, struck Dong Zhang's garrison of more than three thousand and recovered Jian.
entries.literal: On xinsi the western-front army reported: on the thirteenth of this month Jie prefect Wang Hongzan and Lu prefect Feng Hui, from Li by a mountain path outside Jianmen Pass, came down upon Dong Zhang's garrison of more than three thousand and recovered Jian prefecture.

entries.zh: 甲申，日南至，帝御文明殿受朝賀。
entries.en: On jiashen, the winter solstice, Mingzong held audience at the Hall of Civil Splendor for congratulation.
entries.literal: On jiashen, the winter solstice, the Emperor held audience at the Hall of Civil Splendor to receive congratulation.

entries.zh: 丙戌，以給事中鄭韜光為左散騎常侍。
entries.en: On bingxu Zheng Taoguang, supervising secretariat drafter, became Left Regular Attendant at Court.
entries.literal: On bingxu Supervising Secretariat drafter Zheng Taoguang was made Left Regular Attendant at Court.

entries.zh: 青州奏，得登州狀，契丹阿保機男東丹王突欲越海來歸國。
entries.en: Qing reported notice from Deng: Khitan Abaoji's son, Eastern Dan prince Yelü Bei, crossed the sea to return to the dynasty.
entries.literal: Qingzhou reported receiving notice from Deng prefecture: Khitan Abaoji's son, Eastern Dan prince Yelü Bei, crossed the sea to return to the dynasty.

entries.zh: 〈（《契丹國志》：時東丹王失職怨望，因率其部四十餘人越海歸唐。）〉
entries.en: (The 《Khitan State Annals》 says the Eastern Dan prince, displaced and resentful, led more than forty followers across the sea to Tang.)〉
entries.literal: (The 《Khitan State Annals》: At the time the Eastern Dan prince, displaced and resentful, led more than forty of his followers across the sea to return to Tang.)〉

entries.zh: 夏四月辛卯，製德妃王氏進位淑妃。
entries.en: In the fourth month Wang, imperial consort of virtue, was advanced to graceful consort.
entries.literal: Summer, fourth month xinmao: Imperial Consort Virtue Wang was advanced to Lady of Graceful Character.

entries.zh: 詔錢鏐依舊賜不名。
entries.en: Qian Liu was again exempted from having his name written in memorials.
entries.literal: An edict: Qian Liu as before granted the honor of not being named in memorials.

entries.zh: 誅內官安希倫，以其受安重誨密指，令於內中伺帝起居故也。
entries.en: Eunuch An Xilun was executed for spying on Mingzong at An Chonghui's orders.
entries.literal: The inner eunuch An Xilun was executed—for receiving An Chonghui's secret orders to spy on the Emperor's movements within the palace.

entries.zh: 丁酉，幸會節園，宴群臣，因幸河南府。
