entries.en: On dingyou Mingzong feasted officials at the Festival Garden and then visited Henan prefecture.
entries.literal: On dingyou the Emperor visited the Festival Garden, feasted the hundred officials, and then visited Henan prefecture.

entries.zh: 詔罷州縣官到任後率斂為地圖；
entries.en: Officials were forbidden to levy map fees on taking office;
entries.literal: An edict abolished prefectural and county officials on taking office levying funds for maps;

entries.zh: 又禁人毀廢所在碑碣，恐名賢遺行失所考也。
entries.en: and destroying local monuments was banned lest records of worthies be lost.
entries.literal: also forbade people destroying local steles and tablets, fearing famous worthies' surviving conduct would lose verification.

entries.zh: 戊戌，詔今年四月禘饗太廟。
entries.en: On wuxu an edict ordered the di offering at the Grand Temple in the fourth month.
entries.literal: On wuxu an edict: this year's fourth month di offering at the Grand Temple.

entries.zh: 故昭義節度使李嗣昭、故幽州節度使周德威、故汴州節度使符存審，並配饗莊宗廟廷。
entries.en: Li Sizhao, Zhou Dewei, and Fu Cunshen were given collateral offerings in Zhuangzong's temple.
entries.literal: The late Zhaoyi military commissioner Li Sizhao, late Youzhou military commissioner Zhou Dewei, late Bianzhou military commissioner Fu Cunshen—all were collaterally offered in Zhuangzong's temple hall.

entries.zh: 己亥，以前徐州節度使張虔釗為鳳翔節度使。
entries.en: On jihai Zhang Qianzhao of Xuzhou became Fengxiang commissioner.
entries.literal: On jihai former Xuzhou military commissioner Zhang Qianzhao was made Fengxiang military commissioner.

entries.zh: 癸卯，以汴州節度副使藥縱之為戶部侍郎，前宗正卿李諧為將作監。
entries.en: On guimao Yao Zongzhi of Bianzhou became vice revenue minister and Li Xie former clan director became director of works.
entries.literal: On guimao Bianzhou vice commissioner Yao Zongzhi was made Vice Minister of Revenue; former Director of the Imperial Clan Li Xie was made Director of Works.

entries.zh: 甲辰，以宣徽北院使、左衛上將軍趙延壽為檢校太傅、行禮部尚書，充樞密使。
entries.en: On jiachen Zhao Yanshou became inspector grand tutor, acting rites minister, and privy commissioner.
entries.literal: On jiachen Northern Palace Bureau commissioner and Left Guard senior general Zhao Yanshou was made Inspector Grand Tutor, acting Minister of Rites, and Privy Commissioner.

entries.zh: 乙巳，潞州節度使劉仲殷移鎮秦州。
entries.en: On yisi Liu Zhongyin of Lu moved to Qinzhou.
entries.literal: On yisi Lu prefecture military commissioner Liu Zhongyin was transferred to garrison Qin prefecture.

entries.zh: 帝幸龍門佛寺祈雨。
entries.en: Mingzong prayed for rain at Longmen temple.
entries.literal: The Emperor visited Longmen Buddhist temple to pray for rain.

entries.zh: 己酉，天雄軍節度使石敬瑭兼六軍諸衛副使。
entries.en: On jiyou Shi Jingtang of Tianxiong became deputy of the six armies and guards.
entries.literal: On jiyou Tianxiong Army military commissioner Shi Jingtang was made concurrent deputy of the Six Armies and guards.

entries.zh: 辛亥，以前鳳翔節度使朱宏昭為左武衛上將軍，充宣徽南院使。
entries.en: On xinhai Zhu Hongzhao of Fengxiang became left martial guard senior general and southern palace bureau commissioner.
entries.literal: On xinhai former Fengxiang military commissioner Zhu Hongzhao was made Left Martial Guard senior general and Southern Palace Bureau commissioner.

entries.zh: 壬子，以兵部尚書盧質為河陽節度使。
entries.en: On renzi Lu Zhi of war became Heyang commissioner.
entries.literal: On renzi Minister of War Lu Zhi was made Heyang military commissioner.

entries.zh: 甲寅，以遂州節度使夏魯奇沒於王事廢朝。
entries.en: On jiayin Xia Luqi of Suizhou died on duty and court was suspended.
entries.literal: On jiayin Suizhou military commissioner Xia Luqi died in royal service—court suspended.

entries.zh: 詔曰：「久摐時雨，深疚予心。
entries.en: An edict said: "Prolonged drought weighs on our heart.
entries.literal: An edict said: "Long without timely rain—deeply guilty is our heart.

entries.zh: 宜委諸州府長吏親問刑獄，省察冤濫，見禁囚徒，除死罪外，並放。」
entries.en: Let prefectural chiefs review trials, correct wrongful detention, and release all prisoners except those condemned to death."
entries.literal: It is fitting to entrust prefectural and circuit chief officials to personally examine criminal cases, review wrongful and excessive imprisonment; all prisoners in custody—excepting death crimes—all released."

entries.zh: 六月丁巳朔，復置明法科，同《開元禮》。
entries.en: On the dingsi new moon of the sixth month the law examination was restored along with the 《Kaiyuan Rites》.
entries.literal: Sixth month, dingsi new moon: the Clear Law examination was restored, together with the 《Kaiyuan Rites》.

entries.zh: 乙丑，以皇子左衛大將軍從珂依前檢校太傅，加同平章事、行京兆尹，充西都留守。
entries.en: On yichou Li Congke became again inspector grand tutor, grand councillor, acting Jingzhao intendant, and western capital regent.
entries.literal: On yichou the Prince, Left Guard senior general Congke, as before Inspector Grand Tutor, was made concurrent Grand Councillor, acting Jingzhao intendant, Western Capital regent.

entries.zh: 庚午，以邠州節度使張溫為右龍武統軍。
entries.en: On gengwu Zhang Wen of Bin became right dragon martial commander.
entries.literal: On gengwu Binzhou military commissioner Zhang Wen was made Right Dragon Martial commanding general.

entries.zh: 甲戌，以魏征八代孫韶為安定縣主簿。
entries.en: On jiaxu Shao, eighth-generation descendant of Wei Zheng, became Anning county chief clerk.
entries.literal: On jiaxu the eighth-generation descendant of Wei Zheng, Shao, was made Anning county chief clerk.

entries.zh: 乙亥，以鎮州節度使、宋王從厚為興唐尹，以石敬瑭為河陽天雄軍節度使，以天雄軍節度使石敬班為河陽節度使，依前六軍諸衛副使。
entries.en: On yihai Conghou of Song became Xingtang intendant; Shi Jingtang took Heyang-Tianxiong; Shi Jingban took Heyang while keeping six armies deputy.
entries.literal: On yihai Zhenzhou military commissioner, Prince of Song Conghou was made Xingtang intendant; Shi Jingtang was made Heyang-Tianxiong military commissioner; Tianxiong military commissioner Shi Jingban was made Heyang military commissioner, continuing as before deputy of Six Armies and guards.

entries.zh: 丙子，詔諸道觀察使均補苗稅，將有力人戶出剩田畝，補貧下不迨頃畝，有嗣者排改檢括，自今年起為定額。
entries.en: On bingzi circuit inspectors were to equalize seedling tax by reallocating surplus land from wealthy to poor households, with heirs re-surveyed, fixing quotas from this year.
entries.literal: On bingzi an edict: circuit inspectors should evenly supplement seedling tax—take surplus field acres from strong households to supplement poor households short of full mou; where heirs exist, reorder and inspect—from this year as fixed quota.

entries.zh: 乙卯，定州節度使李從敏移鎮州節度使，盧質為滄州節度使。
entries.en: On yimao Li Congmin of Ding moved to Zhen and Lu Zhi became Cang commissioner.
entries.literal: On yimao, Dingzhou military commissioner Li Congmin was transferred to Zhenzhou military commissioner; Lu Zhi was made Cangzhou military commissioner.

entries.zh: 庚辰，皇孫太子舍人重美授司勳員外郎，重真已下六人並授同正將軍及檢校官。
entries.en: On gengchen imperial grandson Chongmei, crown prince aide, became vice director of merit; Chongzhen and six below received honorary regular general and acting commissioner posts.
entries.literal: On gengchen, the imperial grandson and crown prince aide Chongmei was made Vice Director of the Ministry of Merit; Chongzhen and six others below were all made honorary regular generals and acting commissioners.

entries.zh: 壬午，以前秦州節度使李德充為定州節度使兼北面行營副招討使。
entries.en: On renwu former Qin commissioner Li Dechong became Ding commissioner and deputy northern campaign suppression commissioner.
entries.literal: On renwu, former Qinzhou military commissioner Li Dechong was made Dingzhou military commissioner and deputy northern campaign suppression commissioner.

entries.zh: 太原地震。
entries.en: Taiyuan shook.
entries.literal: Taiyuan had an earthquake.

entries.zh: 詔天下州府斷獄，先於案牘之上坐所該律令、格式及新敕，然後區分。
entries.en: Mingzong ordered that in trials everywhere the governing statutes, regulations, and new decrees be placed atop the dossier before judgment.
entries.literal: An edict ordered that in trials throughout the realm, the applicable statutes, regulations, and new decrees must be set atop the dossier first, then judgment rendered.

entries.zh: 乙酉，以前黔州節度使楊漢賓為羽林統軍。
entries.en: On yiyou former Qian commissioner Yang Hanbin became commander of the Feathered Forest.
entries.literal: On yiyou, former Qianzhou military commissioner Yang Hanbin was made commander of the Feathered Forest.

entries.zh: 詔止絕諸射係省店宅莊園。
entries.en: An edict ended seizures of provincial bureau shops, residences, and estates.
entries.literal: An edict halted all seized provincial bureau shops, residences, and estates.

entries.zh: 八月丙寅，詔天下州府商稅務，並委逐處差人依省司年額勾當納官。
entries.en: On bingyin in the eighth month commercial tax offices nationwide were told to appoint local agents to meet annual quotas.
entries.literal: Eighth month, bingyin: an edict ordered commercial tax bureaus throughout the realm to appoint local agents to meet annual provincial quotas and remit to the state.

entries.zh: 以故鎮州節度使、趙王王熔男昭誨為朝議大夫、司農少卿，賜紫金魚袋，繼絕也。
entries.en: Wang Rong's son Zhaohui, heir to the extinct Prince of Zhao line, became court discussant and vice director of agriculture with a purple-gold fish bag.
entries.literal: Deceased Zhenzhou military commissioner and Prince of Zhao Wang Rong's son Zhaohui was made Court Discussant and Vice Director of Agriculture, given purple-gold fish bag—as heir to an extinct line.

entries.zh: 辛丑，升虔州為昭信軍。
entries.en: On xinchou Qianzhou became Zhaoxin circuit.
entries.literal: On xinchou, Qianzhou was elevated to Zhaoxin circuit.

entries.zh: 癸亥，以太常少卿盧文紀為秘書監，以秘書監馬縞為太子賓客，左監門上將軍羅周敬為右領軍上將軍，前懷州刺史婁繼英為左監門上將軍。
entries.en: On guihai Lu Wenji of rites became secretariat director; Ma Gao of the secretariat became crown prince guest; Luo Zhoujing of the left gate became right collar general; former Huai prefect Lou Jiying became left gate general.
entries.literal: On guihai, Deputy Director of Rites Lu Wenji became Director of the Secretariat; Secretariat Director Ma Gao became Crown Prince Guest; Left Gate General Luo Zhoujing became Right Collar General; former Huai prefect Lou Jiying became Left Gate General.

entries.zh: 乙丑，詔：「大理寺官員，宜同台省官例升進，法直官比禮直官任使。
entries.en: On yichou an edict: "Da li officers shall advance like central ministry officials and legal clerks to rank like ritual clerks.
entries.literal: On yichou, an edict: "Da li officers shall advance like central ministry officials; legal clerks ranked like ritual clerks.

entries.zh: 仍於諸道贓罰錢內，每月支錢一百貫文，賜刑部、大理兩司，其刑部於所賜錢三分與一分。」
entries.en: One hundred strings monthly from circuit fines were to go to punishments and Da li, punishments taking one-third."
entries.literal: From circuit fine revenues, one hundred strings monthly to Punishments and Da li; Punishments receives one-third."

entries.zh: 丙寅，以武平軍節度使馬希振依前檢校太尉、兼侍中，充虔州昭信軍節度使。
entries.en: On bingyin Ma Xizhen of Wuping kept grand marshal and palace attendant and became Qian-Zhaoxin commissioner.
entries.literal: On bingyin, Wuping military commissioner Ma Xizhen retained acting Grand Marshal and Palace Attendant and became Qianzhou Zhaoxin military commissioner.

entries.zh: 詔：「百官職吏，應選授外官者，考滿日，並委本州申奏，追還本司，依舊職行公事。」
entries.en: An edict: "Clerks posted outside were to return to their bureaus when terms ended after prefectural memorial."
entries.literal: An edict: "Clerks selected for outside posts, when evaluation ends, the prefecture shall memorialize and recall them to original bureaus to resume duties."

entries.zh: 己巳，太傅致仕王建立、太子少保致仕朱漢賓皆上章求歸鄉里。
entries.en: On jisi retired grand tutor Wang Jianli and retired grand guardian Zhu Hanbin both asked to go home.
entries.literal: On jisi, retired Grand Tutor Wang Jianli and retired Grand Guardian Zhu Hanbin both sought return home.

entries.zh: 詔內外致仕官，凡要出入，不在拘束之限。
entries.en: Retired officials at court and in the provinces were freed from travel restrictions.
entries.literal: An edict: retired officials inward and outward were not bound when traveling on necessary business.

entries.zh: 辛未，以翰林學士、兵部侍郎劉煦守本官，充端明殿學士；
entries.en: On xinwei Liu Xu, Hanlin scholar and war vice minister, kept rank and became a Hall of Bright Comprehension academician;
entries.literal: On xinwei, Hanlin academician and War Vice Minister Liu Xu kept his posts and became Hall of Bright Comprehension academician;

entries.zh: 以左拾遺、直樞密院李崧充樞密直學士。
entries.en: Left Reminder Li Song, direct privy councilor, became privy council academician.
entries.literal: Left Reminder and direct privy councilor Li Song became privy council academician.

entries.zh: 壬申，以左龍武統軍李承約為潞州節度使。
entries.en: On renshen Li Chengyue of the left Majestic Dragon became Lu commissioner.
entries.literal: On renshen, Left Majestic Dragon commander Li Chengyue became Luzhou military commissioner.

entries.zh: 癸酉，詔：「文武百官，五日內殿起居仍舊，其輪次轉對宜停。
entries.en: On guiyou an edict: "Officials keep five-day inner attendance; rotating audience speeches are ended.
entries.literal: On guiyou, an edict: "Civil and military officials keep five-day inner court attendance; rotating audience speech is suspended.

entries.zh: 若有封事，許非時上表，朔望入閣，待制候對，一依舊制。」
entries.en: Sealed memorials could be filed anytime; new- and full-moon palace entry and awaiting audience followed old rules."
entries.literal: Memorials may be filed anytime; new and full moon palace entry and awaiting audience follow old rules."

entries.zh: 乙亥，翰林學士、工部侍郎竇夢徵卒。
entries.en: On yihai Hanlin scholar and works vice minister Dou Mengzheng died.
entries.literal: On yihai, Hanlin academician and Works Vice Minister Dou Mengzheng died.

entries.zh: 丁丑，以前西京副留守梁文矩為兵部尚書。
entries.en: On dingchou former western capital vice defender Liang Wenju became war minister.
entries.literal: On dingchou, former western capital vice defender Liang Wenju became War Minister.

entries.zh: 己卯，詔不得薦銀青階為州縣官。
entries.en: On jimao Mingzong forbade recommending silver-green rank for county posts.
entries.literal: On jimao, an edict forbade recommending silver-green rank for prefectural and county posts.

entries.zh: 壬午，詔應有朝臣、藩侯、郡守，凡欲營葬，未曾封贈，許追封贈。
entries.en: On renwu courtiers, lords, and prefects without prior honors might receive posthumous enfeoffment when burying kin.
entries.literal: On renwu, an edict: courtiers, lords, and prefects planning burial without prior enfeoffment may receive posthumous honors.

entries.zh: 禮部尚書致仕李德休卒。
entries.en: Retired rites minister Li Dexiu died.
entries.literal: Retired Rites Minister Li Dexiu died.

entries.zh: 十二月甲寅朔，詔開鐵禁，許百姓自鑄農器、什器之屬，於夏秋田畝上，每畝輸農器錢一錢五分。
entries.en: On the jiayin new moon in the twelfth month the iron ban was lifted so people could cast farm tools; summer-autumn fields paid one and a half cash per mu.
entries.literal: Twelfth month, jiayin new moon: an edict lifted the iron monopoly, allowing the people to cast farm tools and utensils; on summer-autumn fields, half a coin per mu in tool tax.

entries.zh: 乙卯，畋於西郊。
entries.en: On yimao Mingzong hunted west of the capital.
entries.literal: On yimao, the Emperor hunted in the western suburb.

entries.zh: 丁巳，以彰武軍節度使劉訓卒廢朝。
entries.en: On dingsi Liu Xun of Zhangwu died and court was suspended in mourning.
entries.literal: On dingsi, Zhangwu military commissioner Liu Xun died; court mourning was suspended.

entries.zh: 庚午，以前利州節度使康思立為陝州節度使。
entries.en: On gengwu former Li commissioner Kang Sili became Shan commissioner.
entries.literal: On gengwu, former Lizhou military commissioner Kang Sili became Shanzhou military commissioner.

entries.zh: 秦州地震。
entries.en: Qinzhou shook.
entries.literal: Qinzhou had an earthquake.

entries.zh: 丁丑，詔三司，所過西川兵士家屬，常令贍給。
entries.en: On dingchou the Revenue Commission was ordered to sustain families of soldiers passing through Xichuan.
entries.literal: On dingchou, an edict to the Revenue Commission: families of soldiers passing through Xichuan shall be sustained.

entries.zh: 長興二年春正月庚申朔，帝御明堂殿受朝賀，仗衛如儀。
entries.en: On the gengshen new moon of the first month in spring of Changxing 2 Mingzong received New Year congratulations at the Bright Hall with full ceremonial guard.
entries.literal: In the second year of Changxing, spring, first month, gengshen new moon: the Emperor took the Bright Hall to receive court congratulations; guards and retinue were as prescribed.

entries.zh: 乙丑，詔曰：「故天策上將軍、守太師、尚書令、楚國王馬殷，品位俱高，封崇已極，無官可贈，宜賜諡及神道碑文，仍以王禮葬。」
entries.en: On yichou an edict said: "The late King of Chu Ma Yin, whose ranks were already supreme, could not be given further posts but should receive a posthumous title, spirit-way stele, and royal burial."
entries.literal: On yichou an edict said: "The late Celestial Strategy supreme general, Grand Preceptor, Master of Writing, King of Chu Ma Yin—rank and titles were all high, enfeoffment and honor already at the limit; no office can be conferred in addition—he should be granted a posthumous title and spirit-pathway stele text and be buried with royal rites."

entries.zh: 壬申，契丹東丹王突欲自渤海國率眾到闕，帝慰勞久之，錫賚加等，百僚稱賀。
entries.en: On renshen the Khitan Eastern Dan prince Tuyu arrived from Bohai with his followers; Mingzong received him at length with enhanced gifts while the court congratulated.
entries.literal: On renshen the Khitan Eastern Dan king Tuyu from Bohai led his following to the capital; the Emperor comforted him at length, rewards were raised a grade, and the hundred officials congratulated.

entries.zh: 丙子，以沙州節度使曹義金兼中書令。
entries.en: On bingzi Cao Yijin of Shazhou became concurrent secretariat director.
entries.literal: On bingzi Shazhou military commissioner Cao Yijin was made concurrent Secretariat Director.

entries.zh: 丁丑，東丹王托雲進本國印三紐。
entries.en: On dingchou Eastern Dan king Tuoyun presented three state seals.
entries.literal: On dingchou the Eastern Dan king Tuoyun presented three seals of his state.

entries.zh: 庚辰，以靜江軍節度使馬賓卒廢朝，贈尚書令。
entries.en: On gengchen Ma Bin of Jingjiang died; court was suspended and he was posthumously made master of writing.
entries.literal: On gengchen Jingjiang Army military commissioner Ma Bin died—court suspended; he was posthumously made Master of Writing.

entries.zh: 丙戌，荊南節度使高從誨落起復，加兼中書令。
entries.en: On bingxu Gao Conghui of Jingnan left mourning recall and became concurrent secretariat director.
entries.literal: On bingxu Jingnan military commissioner Gao Conghui was released from mourning recall and made concurrent Secretariat Director.

entries.zh: 六月壬子朔，幽州趙德鈞奏：「新開東南河，自王馬口至淤口，長一百六十五里，闊六十五步，深一丈二尺，以通漕運，舟勝千石，畫圖以獻。」
entries.en: On the renzi new moon in the sixth month Zhao Dejun of You reported: "a new canal from Wangmakou to Yukou—165 li, 65 paces wide, 12 chi deep—for grain transport with thousand-shi vessels, and sent a map."
entries.literal: Sixth month, renzi new moon: Youzhou's Zhao Dejun memorialized: "A new southeastern canal has been opened from Wangmakou to Yukou, one hundred sixty-five li long, sixty-five paces wide, and twelve chi deep, to carry grain transport; vessels may bear a thousand shi; a map is presented."

entries.zh: 甲寅，以權知高麗國事王建為檢校太保，封高麗國王。
entries.en: On jiayin Wang Jian, acting overseer of Goryeo, became honorary grand mentor and king of Goryeo.
entries.literal: On jiayin, Wang Jian, acting overseer of Goryeo affairs, was made honorary Grand Mentor and enfeoffed King of Goryeo.

entries.zh: 丁巳，衛州奏，河水壞堤，東北流入御河。
entries.en: On dingsi Wei reported the river had broken its dikes and poured northeast into the Imperial Canal.
entries.literal: On dingsi, Weizhou memorialized: river water broke the dikes and flowed northeast into the Imperial Canal.

entries.zh: 戊午，荊南奏：「東川董璋領兵至漢州，西川孟知祥出兵逆戰，璋大敗，得部下人二十餘，走入東川城，尋為前陵州刺史王暉所殺，孟知祥已入梓州。」
entries.en: On wuwu Jingnan reported: "Dong Zhang of eastern Sichuan had marched on Han; Meng Zhixiang of western Sichuan met him; Zhang was routed with only twenty-odd followers, fled into the eastern Sichuan capital, was killed by former Ling prefect Wang Hui, and Meng Zhixiang had entered Zizhou."
entries.literal: On wuwu, Jingnan memorialized: "Eastern Sichuan's Dong Zhang led troops to Hanzhou; western Sichuan's Meng Zhixiang sent troops to meet him in battle; Zhang was utterly defeated, taking only twenty-odd of his men; he fled into the eastern Sichuan city and was soon killed by former Ling prefect Wang Hui; Meng Zhixiang has already entered Zizhou."

entries.zh: 辛酉，範延光奏曰：「孟知祥兼有兩川，彼之軍眾皆我之將士，料其外假朝廷形勢以製之，然陛下苟不能屈意招攜，彼亦無由革麵。」
entries.en: On xinyou Fan Yanguang said: "Meng Zhixiang holds both circuits; his soldiers are our men; he likely uses the court's prestige outwardly—but unless Your Majesty humbles yourself to win him, he cannot reform."
entries.literal: On xinyou, Fan Yanguang memorialized, saying: "Meng Zhixiang holds both Sichuans; his troops are all our officers; I reckon that outwardly he borrows the court's prestige to restrain them—yet if Your Majesty cannot humble yourself to win him over, he has no way to change face."

entries.zh: 帝曰：「知祥予故人也，以賊臣間諜，故茲阻隔，今因而撫之，何屈意之有！」
entries.en: Mingzong said: "Zhixiang is my old friend; rebel spies caused the breach; to comfort him now—why humble myself!"
entries.literal: The Emperor said: "Zhixiang is an old friend of mine; rebel ministers and spies caused this estrangement; now to comfort him in the moment—what need to humble oneself!"

entries.zh: 由是遣供奉官李瑰使西川，齎詔以賜知祥。
entries.en: He sent attendant envoy Li Gui to western Sichuan with an edict for Zhixiang.
entries.literal: Thereupon an attendant envoy Li Gui was sent to western Sichuan bearing an edict to bestow on Zhixiang.

entries.zh: 詔以霖雨積旬，久未晴霽，京城諸司係囚，並宜釋放。
entries.en: An edict released all prisoners held by capital offices after ten days of rain without clearing.
entries.literal: An edict: because rain had piled up for ten days and long failed to clear, all prisoners held by the capital offices should be released.

entries.zh: 甲子，以大雨未止，放朝參兩日。
entries.en: On jiazi heavy rain suspended court for two days.
entries.literal: On jiazi, because heavy rain had not ceased, court attendance was suspended for two days.

entries.zh: 洛水漲泛二丈，廬舍居民有溺死者。
entries.en: The Luo rose two zhang; houses and people drowned.
entries.literal: The Luo River rose more than two zhang; houses and residents were drowned.

entries.zh: 以前濮州刺史武延翰為右領軍上將軍，前階州刺史王宏贄為左千牛上將軍。
entries.en: Wu Yanhan, former Pu prefect, became right army senior general; Wang Hongzan of Jie became left palace guard senior general.
entries.literal: Former Pu prefect Wu Yanhan was made Right Army senior general; former Jie prefect Wang Hongzan was made Left Palace Guard senior general.

entries.zh: 金、徐、安、潁等州大水，鎮州旱。
entries.en: Jin, Xu, An, Ying, and others flooded; Zhen had drought.
entries.literal: Jin, Xu, An, Ying, and other prefectures had great floods; Zhenzhou had drought.

entries.zh: 詔應水旱州郡，各遣使人存問。
entries.en: An edict ordered flood- and drought-struck prefectures to send envoys to inquire after the people.
entries.literal: An edict ordered every prefecture and commandery suffering flood or drought to send envoys to inquire after the people.

entries.zh: 秋七月辛巳朔，以天下兵馬元帥、尚父、吳越國王錢鏐薨，廢朝三日。
entries.en: On the xinsi new moon in the seventh month Qian Liu, grand marshal, imperial father, and king of Wu-Yue, died; court was suspended three days.
entries.literal: Seventh month, autumn, xinsi new moon: Qian Liu, Grand Marshal of All Armies and Horses, Imperial Father, and King of Wu-Yue, died; court was suspended three days.

entries.zh: 丙戌，詔賜諸軍救接錢有差。
entries.en: On bingxu relief money was graded to the armies.
entries.literal: On bingxu, an edict bestowed relief money on the various armies in graded amounts.

entries.zh: 戊子，正衙命使冊高麗國王王建。
entries.en: On wuzi main-court envoys invested Wang Jian as king of Goryeo.
entries.literal: On wuzi, envoys at the main court were ordered to invest Wang Jian as King of Goryeo.

entries.zh: 靈武奏，夏州界党項七百騎侵擾，當道出師擊破之，生擒五十騎，追至賀蘭山下。
entries.en: Lingwu reported seven hundred Tangut horsemen had raided the Xia border; circuit troops routed them, took fifty alive, and pursued to Helan.
entries.literal: Lingwu memorialized: seven hundred Tangut horsemen on the Xiazhou border raided; the circuit sent troops and routed them, taking fifty horsemen alive and pursuing to below Helan Mountain.

entries.zh: 己丑，兩浙節度使錢元尞起復，加守尚書令。
entries.en: On jichou Qian Yuanliao, military governor of Liangzhe, returned to office before completing mourning and received the additional title of acting Director of the Department of State Affairs.
entries.literal: On jichou Qian Yuanliao, military governor of Liangzhe, returned to office before completing mourning and received the additional title of acting Director of the Department of State Affairs.

entries.zh: 青州節度使王晏球加兼中書令。
entries.en: Wang Yanqiu of Qing was also made concurrent grand councilor.
entries.literal: Qingzhou military commissioner Wang Yanqiu was additionally made Concurrent Grand Councilor.

entries.zh: 秦、鳳、兗、宋、亳、潁、鄧大水，漂邑屋，損苗稼。
entries.en: Qin, Feng, Yan, Song, Bo, Ying, and Deng flooded, sweeping towns and damaging crops.
entries.literal: Qin, Feng, Yan, Song, Bo, Ying, and Deng had great floods that swept towns and houses and damaged crops.

entries.zh: 夔州赤甲山崩。
entries.en: Chijia Mountain in Kui collapsed.
entries.literal: Kuizhou's Chijia Mountain collapsed.

entries.zh: 壬辰，以前太僕卿鄭繢為鴻臚卿，以前兗州行軍司馬李鈴為戶部尚書。
entries.en: On renchen Zheng Hui, former grand stablemaster, became director of diplomatic reception; Li Ling, former Yan campaign deputy, became minister of revenue.
entries.literal: On renchen, former Grand Stablemaster Zheng Hui was made Director of the Court for Diplomatic Reception; former Yanzhou campaign deputy Li Ling was made Minister of Revenue.

entries.zh: 乙未，福建節度使王延鈞進絹表云：「吳越王錢鏐薨，乞封臣為吳越王。
entries.en: On yiwei Wang Yanjun, military governor of Fujian, submitted a memorial with a gift of silk: "Qian Liu, King of Wuyue, has died. I ask to be enfeoffed as King of Wuyue.
entries.literal: On yiwei, Fujian military commissioner Wang Yanjun presented a silk memorial, saying: "King of Wu-Yue Qian Liu has died; I beg to be enfeoffed King of Wu-Yue.

entries.zh: 湖南馬殷官是尚書令，殷薨，請授臣尚書令。」
entries.en: Ma Yin of Hunan held the title Director of the Department of State Affairs. Now that he is dead, I ask that this title be granted to me."
entries.literal: Ma Yin of Hunan held the title Director of the Department of State Affairs. Now that Yin has died, I ask that the title Director of the Department of State Affairs be granted to me."

entries.zh: 不報。
entries.en: The court did not reply.
entries.literal: No reply was given.

entries.zh: 戊戌，太子賓客李光憲以禮部尚書致仕。
entries.en: On wuxu Li Guangxian, crown prince mentor, retired as minister of rites.
entries.literal: On wuxu, Crown Prince Mentor Li Guangxian retired as Minister of Rites.

entries.zh: 己亥，以前靈武節度使康福為涇州節度使。
entries.en: On jihai Kang Fu, former Ling commissioner, became Jing commissioner.
entries.literal: On jihai, former Lingwu military commissioner Kang Fu was made Jingzhou military commissioner.

entries.zh: 幽州衙將潘杲上言，知故使劉仁恭於大安山藏錢之所，樞密院差人監往發之，竟無所得。
entries.en: Pan Gao, Youzhou headquarters officer, said he knew Liu Rengong's money cache on Mount Da'an; the Privy Council supervised digging but found nothing.
entries.literal: Youzhou headquarters officer Pan Gao submitted word that he knew where former commissioner Liu Rengong had hidden money on Mount Da'an; the Privy Council sent men to supervise opening it, but in the end nothing was obtained.

entries.zh: 以皇子西京留守、京兆尹從珂為鳳翔節度使。
entries.en: Congke, imperial prince, western capital regent, and Jingzhao prefect, became Fengxiang commissioner.
entries.literal: The imperial prince, western capital regent, and Jingzhao prefect Congke was made Fengxiang military commissioner.

entries.zh: 廢鳳州武興軍節制為防禦使，並所管興、文二州並依舊隸興元府。
entries.en: Feng's Wuxing army command became a defense post; Xing and Wen returned to Xingyuan as before.
entries.literal: Fengzhou's Wuxing Army command was abolished to defense commissioner; the Xing and Wen prefectures it governed were restored to Xingyuan prefecture as before.

entries.zh: 丁未，以門下侍郎兼吏部尚書、同平章事、監修國史趙鳳為檢校太傅、同平章事，充邢州節度使。
entries.en: On dingwei Zhao Feng, Vice Director of the Secretariat, concurrently Minister of Personnel, Grand Counselor, and supervising compiler of state history, became honorary Grand Mentor and Grand Counselor while serving as military governor of Xingzhou.
entries.literal: On dingwei, Vice Director of the Secretariat, Concurrent Minister of Personnel, Grand Councilor, and supervising compiler of state history Zhao Feng was made honorary Grand Mentor and Grand Councilor, filling the post of Xingzhou military commissioner.

entries.zh: 詔諸州府遭水人戶各支借麥種及等第賑貸。
entries.en: An edict ordered flood-hit prefectures to lend wheat seed and grant graded relief.
entries.literal: An edict ordered every prefecture and commandery struck by flood to lend wheat seed to households and grant graded relief loans.

entries.zh: 冬十月己酉朔，再遣供奉官李瑰使西川，兼押賜故福慶長公主祭贈絹三千匹，並賜知祥玉帶。
entries.en: On the jiyou new moon in the tenth month Li Gui was again sent to western Sichuan with three thousand bolts of silk for the late Princess of Blessing and Celebration and a jade belt for Zhixiang.
entries.literal: Tenth month, winter, jiyou new moon: attendant envoy Li Gui was again sent to western Sichuan, also escorting three thousand bolts of silk for funeral offerings to the late Princess of Blessing and Celebration and bestowing on Zhixiang a jade belt.

entries.zh: 先是，兩川隔遠，朝廷兵士不下三萬人，至是，知祥上表乞發遣兵士家屬入川，詔報不允。
entries.en: Earlier the circuits were remote and fewer than thirty thousand court troops were there; now Zhixiang asked to bring soldiers' families in; the court refused.
entries.literal: Earlier the two Sichuans were remote and court troops there were fewer than thirty thousand; now Zhixiang memorialized asking to send soldiers' families into Sichuan; an edict replied that it was not approved.

entries.zh: 知祥所奏兩川部內文武將吏，乞許權行墨製除補訖奏，詔許之。
entries.en: Zhixiang asked to appoint civil and military officers in both circuits by provisional ink edict and report afterward; the court allowed it.
entries.literal: Zhixiang's memorial on civil and military officers within the two Sichuans asked permission to provisionally appoint by ink edict and report after the fact; an edict permitted it.

entries.zh: 知祥所奏立功大將趙季良等五人正授節鉞，續有處分。
entries.en: Zhixiang asked regular commissioner seals for Zhao Jiliang and four other meritorious generals; further orders would follow.
entries.literal: Zhixiang's memorial on meritorious great generals Zhao Jiliang and four others asked regular investiture with military commissioners; further disposition would follow.

entries.zh: 襄州奏，漢水溢，壞民廬舍。
entries.en: Xiang reported the Han had overflowed and wrecked houses.
entries.literal: Xiangzhou memorialized: the Han River overflowed and destroyed commoners' houses.

entries.zh: 癸丑，以太常卿劉嶽卒廢朝。
entries.en: On guichou Liu Yue, director of imperial sacrifices, died and court was suspended.
entries.literal: On guichou, because Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Liu Yue died, court was suspended.

entries.zh: 己未，以兵部侍郎張文寶為吏部侍郎，以戶部侍郎藥縱之為兵部侍郎。
entries.en: On jiwei Zhang Wenbao became personnel vice minister; Yao Zongzhi became war vice minister.
entries.literal: On jiwei, Vice Minister of War Zhang Wenbao was made Vice Minister of Personnel; Vice Minister of Revenue Yao Zongzhi was made Vice Minister of War.

entries.zh: 庚申，幸至德宮，因幸石敬瑭、李從昶、李從敏之第。
entries.en: On gengshen Mingzong visited the Palace of Highest Virtue, then the homes of Shi Jingtang, Li Congchang, and Li Congmin.
entries.literal: On gengshen, the Emperor visited the Palace of Highest Virtue and then visited the residences of Shi Jingtang, Li Congchang, and Li Congmin.

entries.zh: 壬申，大理少卿康澄上疏曰：「臣聞安危得失，治亂興亡，誠不係於天時，固非由於地利，童謠非禍福之本，妖祥豈隆替之源！
entries.en: On renshen Kang Cheng, assistant director of judicial review, wrote: "Safety and danger, order and chaos, do not hang on heaven or earth; rhymes are not fortune's root and omens are not fate's source!
entries.literal: On renshen, Assistant Director of the Court of Judicial Review Kang Cheng submitted a memorial, saying: "Your subject has heard that safety and danger, gain and loss, order and chaos, rise and fall truly do not depend on heavenly timing and surely are not due to earthly advantage; children's rhymes are not the root of fortune and disaster, and strange omens are hardly the source of ascent and decline!

entries.zh: 故雊雉升鼎而桑穀生朝，不能止殷宗之盛；
entries.en: A crowing pheasant on the tripod and mulberry grain in court did not stop the Yin ancestor's rise;
entries.literal: Thus when a crowing pheasant mounted the tripod and mulberry and grain grew in the court, they could not stop the Yin ancestor's flourishing;

entries.zh: 神馬長嘶而玉龜告兆，不能延晉祚之長。
entries.en: a divine horse's long neigh and a jade tortoise's omen did not lengthen Jin's mandate.
entries.literal: when a divine horse neighed long and a jade tortoise announced a portent, they could not extend Jin's mandate long.

entries.zh: 是知國家有不足懼者五，有深可畏者六。
entries.en: The state has five things not worth fearing and six deeply to be feared.
entries.literal: Thus one knows the state has five things not worth fearing and six things deeply to be feared.

entries.zh: 陰陽不調不足懼，三辰失行不足懼，小人訛言不足懼，山崩川涸不足懼，蟊賊傷稼不足懼，此不足懼者五也。
entries.en: Discord of yin and yang, errant stars, petty lies, collapsed mountains and dry rivers, and locusts in the fields are not worth fearing—these five.
entries.literal: Yin and yang out of tune is not worth fearing; the three luminaries off course is not worth fearing; petty men's false words are not worth fearing; mountains collapsing and rivers drying are not worth fearing; locusts harming crops is not worth fearing—these are the five not worth fearing.

entries.zh: 賢人藏匿深可畏，四民遷業深可畏，上下相徇深可畏，廉恥道消深可畏，毀譽亂真深可畏，直言蔑聞深可畏，此深可畏者六也。
entries.en: Hidden worthies, trades abandoned, mutual cover between high and low, faded integrity, slander confusing truth, and straight counsel ignored—these six are deeply to be feared.
entries.literal: Worthies in hiding is deeply to be feared; the four classes changing trades is deeply to be feared; superiors and inferiors covering for each other is deeply to be feared; the way of integrity and shame fading is deeply to be feared; slander and praise confusing truth is deeply to be feared; straight words scorned and unheard is deeply to be feared—these are the six deeply to be feared.

entries.zh: 伏惟陛下尊臨萬國，奄有八紘，蕩三季之澆風，振百王之舊典，設四科而羅俊彥，提二柄而禦英雄。
entries.en: Your Majesty rules ten thousand states and the eight directions, sweeps three ages of decadence, revives a hundred kings' canons, sets four categories to gather talent, and wields two handles to control heroes.
entries.literal: I bow before Your Majesty, honored above ten thousand states, holding the eight directions, sweeping the decadent winds of three degenerate ages, reviving the old canons of a hundred kings, setting the four categories to gather the outstanding, and wielding the two handles to control heroes.

entries.zh: 所以不軌不物之徒，咸思革麵；
entries.en: Those outside the track and norm all wish to reform;
entries.literal: Therefore those outside the track and outside the norm all wish to change face;

entries.zh: 無禮無儀之輩，相率悛心。
entries.en: the rude and unmannered repent in succession.
entries.literal: the ranks without rites and without ceremony one after another repent their hearts.

entries.zh: 然而不足懼者，願陛下存而勿論；
entries.en: What is not worth fearing, may Your Majesty keep and pass over;
entries.literal: Yet as to what is not worth fearing, I wish Your Majesty to keep it and not discuss it;

entries.zh: 深可畏者，願陛下修而靡忒。
entries.en: what is deeply to be feared, may Your Majesty cultivate without wavering.
entries.literal: what is deeply to be feared, I wish Your Majesty to cultivate it without deviation.

entries.zh: 加以崇三綱五常之教，敷六府三事之歌，則鴻基與五嶽爭高，盛業共磐石永固。」
entries.en: Exalt the three bonds and five constants and spread the song of the six storehouses and three affairs, and the foundation will rival the five peaks and the enterprise stand firm as bedrock."
entries.literal: Add to this exalting the teaching of the three bonds and five constants and spreading the song of the six storehouses and three affairs, then the great foundation will vie in height with the five peaks and the flourishing enterprise will be firm as bedrock forever."

entries.zh: 優詔獎之。
entries.en: A gracious edict praised him.
entries.literal: A gracious edict praised him.

entries.zh: 澄言可畏六事，實中當時之病，識者許之。
entries.en: Cheng's six fears struck the age's sickness; critics approved.
entries.literal: Cheng's six fearful matters truly hit the sickness of the time; the knowing approved.

entries.zh: 癸酉，湖南馬希範、荊南高從誨並進銀及茶，乞賜戰馬，帝還其直，各賜馬有差。
entries.en: On guiyou Ma Xifan of Hunan and Gao Conghui of Jingnan offered silver and tea for war horses; Mingzong returned the price and gave horses in graded amounts.
entries.literal: On guiyou, Hunan's Ma Xifan and Jingnan's Gao Conghui each presented silver and tea and begged battle horses; the Emperor returned their price and bestowed horses in graded amounts.

entries.zh: 丁丑，帝謂範延光曰：「如聞禁軍戍守，多不稟藩臣之命，緩急如何驅使？」
entries.en: On dingchou Mingzong told Fan Yanguang: "Garrison guards often ignore circuit commissioners—how drive them in crisis?"
entries.literal: On dingchou, the Emperor said to Fan Yanguang: "I hear that when the imperial guard garrisons, many do not obey the circuit commissioner's orders—in urgency how can they be driven?"

entries.zh: 延光曰：「承前禁軍出戍，便令逐處守臣管轄斷決，近似簡易。」
entries.en: Yanguang said: "By precedent garrison guards on duty were judged by local defenders—nearly simple."
entries.literal: Yanguang said: "Following precedent, when the imperial guard goes out to garrison, the local defending commissioner is put in charge of judgment and decision—nearly simple."

entries.zh: 帝曰：「速以宣命條舉之。」
entries.en: Mingzong said: "Draw up an edict at once."
entries.literal: The Emperor said: "Quickly draw up an edict in items and present it."

entries.zh: 十一月辛巳，以三司使、左武衛大將軍孟鵠為許州節度使，以前許州節度使馮贇為宣徽使、判三司，以宣徽北院使孟漢瓊判院事。
entries.en: On xinsi in the eleventh month, Meng Hu, Commissioner of the Three Financial Bureaus and Senior General of the Left Martial Guard, was appointed military governor of Xu Prefecture; former Xu Prefecture military governor Feng Yun was appointed Palace Commissioner and placed in charge of the Three Financial Bureaus; and Northern Bureau Palace Commissioner Meng Hanqiong was placed in charge of the bureau's affairs.
entries.literal: Eleventh month, xinsi: Commissioner of the Three Financial Bureaus and Left Martial Guard Senior General Meng Hu was made military governor of Xu Prefecture; former Xu Prefecture military governor Feng Yun was made Palace Commissioner and placed in charge of the Three Financial Bureaus; Northern Bureau Palace Commissioner Meng Hanqiong was placed in charge of the bureau's affairs.

entries.zh: 壬午，史館奏：「宣宗已下四廟未有實錄，請下兩浙、荊湖購募野史及除目報狀。」
entries.en: On renwu the Historiographic Office said: "From Xuanzong onward the four temple veritable records are missing; we ask Liang-Zhe and Jing-Hu to buy unofficial histories and appointment reports."
entries.literal: On renwu, the Historiographic Office memorialized: "From Emperor Xuanzong down, the four temple veritable records do not yet exist; we beg orders to Liang-Zhe and Jing-Hu to purchase unofficial histories and appointment reports."

entries.zh: 從之。
entries.en: Approved.
entries.literal: It was approved.

entries.zh: 〈（：《五代會要》載十一月四日，史館奏：當館昨為大中以來，迄於天祐，四朝實錄，尚未纂修，尋具奏聞，謹行購募。
entries.en: (The 《Five Dynasties Essentials》 says: on the fourth of the eleventh month the Historiographic Office reported that veritable records from Dazhong through Tianyou were still uncompiled and procurement had begun.
entries.literal: (The 《Five Dynasties Essentials》 records: on the fourth day of the eleventh month the Historiographic Office memorialized: "This office, for the four reign veritable records from the Dazhong era through Tianyou, has not yet compiled them; we have already memorialized and respectfully undertake procurement.

entries.zh: 敕命雖頒於數月，圖書未貢於一編。
entries.en: Months after the edict, not one book had arrived.
entries.literal: Though the edict was issued months ago, not one compilation of books has been presented.

entries.zh: 蓋以北土州城，久罹兵火，遂成滅絕，難可訪求。
entries.en: Northern cities had long burned in war and sources were gone.
entries.literal: This is because northern prefectures and cities long suffered war and fire until extinction, hard to seek out.

entries.zh: 切恐歲月漸深，耳目不接，長為闕典，過在攸司。
entries.en: Years would sever witnesses and leave a lasting gap—the office was at fault.
entries.literal: I fear that as years deepen and witnesses are cut off, it will long be a missing canon—the fault lies in this office.

entries.zh: 伏念江表列藩，湖南奧壞，至於閩、越，方屬勳賢。
entries.en: The Yangtze circuits, rich Hunan, and Min and Yue were held by meritorious lords.
entries.literal: I reflect that the Yangtze circuits, Hunan's rich region, and as for Min and Yue, are now held by meritorious worthies.

entries.zh: 戈鋌自擾於中原，屏翰悉全於外府，固多奇士，富有群書。
entries.en: War had ravaged the center while outer prefectures stood intact, with scholars and books in plenty.
entries.literal: Weapons have troubled the central plain while screen defenders remain whole in outer prefectures—surely many unusual scholars and rich collections of books.

entries.zh: 其兩浙、福建、湖廣伏乞詔旨，委各於本道采訪宣宗、懿宗、僖宗、昭宗以上四朝野史，及逐朝日曆、銀台事宜、內外製詞、百司沿革簿籍，不限卷數，據有者抄錄上進。
entries.en: For Liang-Zhe, Fujian, and Huguang it asked edicts to seek from Xuanzong through Zhaozong unofficial histories, calendars, Silver Terrace records, edicts, and office registers, copying all held copies.
entries.literal: For Liang-Zhe, Fujian, and Huguang I beg an edict commissioning each circuit to seek unofficial histories of the four reigns from Xuanzong, Yizong, Xizong, and Zhaozong upward, and each reign's calendars, Silver Terrace affairs, inner and outer edicts, and hundred-office evolution registers, without limit on juan—copy and submit what exists.

entries.zh: 若民間收得，或隱士撰成，即令各列姓名，請議爵賞。）〉
entries.en: Private finds or recluse compilations should list names for rank and reward.)〉
entries.literal: If the people have recovered them or recluses have compiled them, let each list his name and request rank and reward.)〉

entries.zh: 癸未，以左僕射致仕鄭玨卒廢朝。
entries.en: On guiwei Zheng Jue, retired left vice director, died and court was suspended.
entries.literal: On guiwei, because Left Vice Director of the Secretariat Zheng Jue, retired, died, court was suspended.

entries.zh: 丁亥，以河陽節度使兼六軍諸衛副使石敬瑭為河東節度使，兼大同、彰國、振武、威塞等軍蕃漢馬步總管。
entries.en: On dinghai Shi Jingtang of Heyang, deputy Six Armies commander, became Hedong commissioner and overall Tangut-Han commander of Datong, Zhangguo, Zhenwu, Weisai, and other armies.
entries.literal: On dinghai, Heyang military commissioner and deputy overall commander of the Six Army guards Shi Jingtang was made Hedong military commissioner and overall commander of Tangut and Han horse and foot of Datong, Zhangguo, Zhenwu, Weisai, and other armies.

entries.zh: 時契丹帳族在雲州境上，與群臣議擇威望大臣以製北方，故有是命。
entries.en: Khitan tents were on the Yun border; ministers chose a prestigious northward commander—hence the order.
entries.literal: At the time Khitan tent clans were on the Yunzhou border; with the hundred officials he discussed choosing a minister of prestige to control the north—hence this appointment.

entries.zh: 己丑，樞密使趙延壽加同平章事。
entries.en: On jichou Zhao Yanshou of the Privy Council was also made grand councilor.
entries.literal: On jichou, Privy Council commissioner Zhao Yanshou was additionally made Grand Councilor.

entries.zh: 詔在京臣僚，不得進奉賀長至馬及諸物。
entries.en: An edict barred capital officials from solstice tribute horses or goods.
entries.literal: An edict: capital officials may not present tribute horses or other goods for congratulating the winter solstice.

entries.zh: 甲午，日南至，帝御文明殿受朝賀。
entries.en: On jiawu, the solstice, Mingzong received congratulations at the Hall of Civilization.
entries.literal: On jiawu, the winter solstice: the Emperor held court at the Hall of Civilization and received congratulation.

entries.zh: 己亥，河中節度使李從璋加檢校太傅，以右散騎常侍楊凝式為工部侍郎。
entries.en: On jihai Li Congzhang of Hezhong became honorary grand mentor; Yang Ningshi became works vice minister.
entries.literal: On jihai, Hezhong military commissioner Li Congzhang was made honorary Grand Mentor; Right Regular Attendant Yang Ningshi was made Vice Minister of Works.

entries.zh: 庚子，以秘書監盧文紀為工部尚書，以工部尚書崔居儉為太常卿，以工部侍郎鄭韜光為禮部侍郎。
entries.en: On gengzi Lu Wenji became works minister; Cui Jujian became sacrifices director; Zheng Taoguang became rites vice minister.
entries.literal: On gengzi, Director of the Secretariat Lu Wenji was made Minister of Works; Minister of Works Cui Jujian was made Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices; Vice Minister of Works Zheng Taoguang was made Vice Minister of Rites.

entries.zh: 乙巳，雲州奏，契丹主在黑榆林南捺剌泊造攻城之具。
entries.en: On yisi Yun reported the Khitan ruler was building siege engines south of Black Willow Forest at Nalabo.
entries.literal: On yisi, Yunzhou memorialized: the Khitan ruler south of Black Willow Forest at Nalabo was making siege engines.

entries.zh: 帝遣使賜契丹主銀器彩帛。
entries.en: Mingzong sent silver vessels and silks to the Khitan ruler.
entries.literal: The Emperor sent envoys to bestow silver vessels and colored silks on the Khitan ruler.

entries.zh: 長興三年春正月癸未朔，帝御明堂殿受朝賀，仗衛如式。
entries.en: On the guiwei new moon of the first month in spring of Changxing 3 Mingzong received New Year congratulations at the Bright Hall with full ceremonial guard.
entries.literal: In the third year of Changxing, spring, first month, guiwei new moon: the Emperor took the Bright Hall palace to receive court congratulations; guards and retinue were as prescribed.

entries.zh: 丁亥，陝州節度使安從進移鎮延州。
entries.en: On dinghai An Congjin of Shanzhou moved to Yanzhou.
entries.literal: On dinghai Shanzhou military commissioner An Congjin was transferred to garrison Yan prefecture.

entries.zh: 己丑，遣邠州節度使藥彥稠、靈武節度使康福率步騎七千往方渠討党項之叛者。
entries.en: On jichou Yao Yanchou of Bin and Kang Fu of Lingwu led seven thousand troops to Fangqu against Tangut rebels.
entries.literal: On jichou Binzhou military commissioner Yao Yanchou and Lingwu military commissioner Kang Fu were sent leading seven thousand foot and horse to Fangqu to suppress the Tangut rebels.

entries.zh: 庚寅，以前北京副留守呂夢奇為戶部侍郎。
entries.en: On gengyin former Beijing vice regent Lü Mengqi became vice revenue minister.
entries.literal: On gengyin former Beijing vice regent Lü Mengqi was made Vice Minister of Revenue.

entries.zh: 辛卯，以前彰國軍留後孫漢韶為利州節度使，充西面行營副部署兼步軍都指揮使。
entries.en: On xinmao Sun Hanshao of Zhangguo became Lizhou commissioner, western campaign deputy marshal, and foot-army commander.
entries.literal: On xinmao former Zhangguo Army regent Sun Hanshao was made Lizhou military commissioner, filling western campaign deputy marshal and concurrent foot-army commander-in-chief.

entries.zh: 庚子，契丹遣使朝貢。
entries.en: On gengzi the Khitan presented tribute.
entries.literal: On gengzi the Khitan sent envoys to court with tribute.

entries.zh: 辛丑，秦王從榮加開府儀同三司、兼中書令。
entries.en: On xinchou Li Congrong, Prince of Qin, was granted the honor of Open Office with Rank Equal to the Three Excellencies and concurrently appointed Director of the Secretariat.
entries.literal: On xinchou Li Congrong, Prince of Qin, was granted the honor of Open Office with Rank Equal to the Three Excellencies and concurrently appointed Director of the Secretariat.

entries.zh: 戊申，詔選人文解不合式樣，罪在發解官吏，舉人落第，次年免取文解。
entries.en: On wushen an edict blamed dispatching officials when candidates' essays failed format and exempted failed candidates from essays the next year.
entries.literal: On wushen an edict: civil service candidates' qualification essays not matching the prescribed form—the fault lies with the dispatching officials; failed candidates the next year are exempt from submitting qualification essays.

entries.zh: 中書門下奏：「請親王官至兼侍中、中書令，則與見任宰臣分班定位，宰臣居左，諸親王居右。
entries.en: The secretariat asked that "princes who held concurrent vice director or secretariat director rank stand in a separate row to the right of sitting chancellors on the left.
entries.literal: The Secretariat memorialized: "Request that when princes reach the rank of concurrent Vice Director or Secretariat Director, they form separate rows with incumbent chancellors for positioning—chancellors on the left, all princes on the right.

entries.zh: 如親王及諸使守侍中、中書令，亦分行居右，其餘使相依舊。」
entries.en: Princes and commissioners with those titles would also stand right; other commissioners unchanged."
entries.literal: If princes and various commissioners hold Vice Director or Secretariat Director, they too form rows on the right; the rest of commissioners follow the old rule."

entries.zh: 從之。
entries.en: Approved.
entries.literal: It was approved.

entries.zh: 渤海、回鶻、吐蕃遣使朝貢。
entries.en: Bohai, Uighurs, and Tibet sent tributary envoys.
entries.literal: Bohai, Uighur, and Tibetan envoys came to court with tribute.

entries.zh: 大理正張居錄上言：「所頒諸州新定格式、律令，請委逐處各差法直官一人，專掌檢討。」
entries.en: Grand justice Zhang Jilu asked: "Each prefecture should appoint one legal examiner to check newly issued regulations and statutes."
entries.literal: Grand justice Zhang Jilu memorialized: "The newly fixed regulations and statutes issued to all prefectures—request that each place appoint one legal examiner to specialize in checking them."

entries.zh: 從之。
entries.en: Approved.
entries.literal: It was approved.

entries.zh: 四年十一月二十日，秦王誅。
entries.en: On the twentieth day of the eleventh month of the fourth year, the Prince of Qin was put to death.
entries.literal: On the twentieth day of the eleventh month of the fourth year, the Prince of Qin was executed.

entries.zh: 翌日，明宗遣宣徽使孟漢瓊馳驛召帝，二十六日，明宗崩，二十九日，帝至自鄴。
entries.en: The next day Mingzong sent Meng Hanqiong, Palace Attendant envoy, by express relay to summon him. On the twenty-sixth Mingzong died; on the twenty-ninth the Emperor arrived from Ye.
entries.literal: The next day Mingzong dispatched Palace Attendant envoy Meng Hanqiong by express relay to summon the Emperor; on the twenty-sixth Mingzong died; on the twenty-ninth the Emperor arrived from Ye.

entries.zh: 十二月癸卯朔，發喪於西宮，帝於柩前即位。
entries.en: On the guimao new moon of the twelfth month mourning was proclaimed at the Western Palace, and the Emperor took the throne before the coffin.
entries.literal: Twelfth month guimao new moon: mourning was proclaimed at the Western Palace; the Emperor assumed the throne before the bier.

entries.zh: 丁未，群臣上表請聽政，表再上，詔允。
entries.en: On dingwei the ministers memorialized asking him to take up governance. When the memorial was submitted a second time, an edict granted the request.
entries.literal: On dingwei the ministers memorialized requesting that he assume governance; the memorial was submitted again, and an edict granted it.

entries.zh: 己酉，中外將士給賜有差。
entries.en: On jiyou soldiers and officers inside and outside the capital received stipends and gifts according to rank.
entries.literal: On jiyou inner and outer military officers received differentiated stipends and gifts.

entries.zh: 庚戌，帝縗服見群臣於廣壽門之東廡下，宰臣馮道進曰：「陛下久居哀毀，臣等鹹願一睹聖顏。」
entries.en: On gengxu the Emperor, still in hemp mourning, met the ministers under the eastern portico of the Gate of Broad Longevity. Chief minister Feng Dao stepped forward and said, "Your Majesty has long kept to grief and fasting; we all long to see your face again."
entries.literal: On gengxu the Emperor in hemp mourning garments met the ministers under the eastern portico of the Gate of Broad Longevity; chief minister Feng Dao advanced and said: "Your Majesty has long remained in grief and self-abnegation; we all wish to behold your sacred countenance."

entries.zh: 朱宏昭前舉帽，群臣再拜而退。
entries.en: Zhu Hongzhao stepped forward and lifted his cap; the ministers bowed twice and withdrew.
entries.literal: Zhu Hongzhao stepped forward and raised his cap; the ministers bowed twice and withdrew.

entries.zh: 禦光政樓存問軍民。
entries.en: He went to the Hall of Radiant Governance to inquire after soldiers and civilians.
entries.literal: He took the Hall of Radiant Governance to inquire after soldiers and civilians.

entries.zh: 辛亥，賜司衣王氏死，坐秦王事也。
entries.en: On xinhai Lady Wang of the Wardrobe Service was sentenced to death for her part in the Prince of Qin affair.
entries.literal: On xinhai Lady Wang of the Wardrobe Service was granted death, on account of the Prince of Qin affair.

entries.zh: 癸丑，以前鎮州節度使、涇王從敏權知河南府事，尋以盧質代之。
entries.en: On guichou Congmin, Prince of Jing and former commissioner of Zhenzhou, was made acting mayor of Henan; Lu Zhi soon replaced him.
entries.literal: On guichou former Zhenzhou military commissioner, Prince of Jing Congmin was appointed acting Mayor of Henan; soon Lu Zhi replaced him.

entries.zh: 乙卯，賜司儀康氏死，事連王氏也。
entries.en: On yimao Lady Kang of the Ceremonial Service was sentenced to death in connection with Lady Wang's case.
entries.literal: On yimao Lady Kang of the Ceremonial Service was granted death; the matter was linked to Lady Wang.

entries.zh: 丙辰，以天雄軍節度判官唐汭為諫議大夫，掌書記趙彖為起居郎，元從都押衙宋令詢為磁州刺史。
entries.en: On bingchen Tang Rui, adjutant of the Tianxiong Army, was made Remonstrance Counsellor; Zhao Tuan, chief secretary, became Gentleman of the Imperial Diary; and Song Lingxun, chief military aide from the Emperor's original entourage, was made prefect of Cizhou.
entries.literal: On bingchen Tianxiong Army adjutant Tang Rui was made Remonstrance Counsellor; chief secretary Zhao Tuan was made Gentleman of the Imperial Diary; original follower chief military aide Song Lingxun was made Cizhou prefect.

entries.zh: 丁巳，以左僕射、平章事馮道為山陵使，戶部尚書韓彥惲為副，中書舍人王延為判官，禮部尚書王權為禮儀使，兵部尚書李鈴為鹵簿使，御史中丞龍敏為儀仗使，右僕射、權知河南府盧質為橋道頓遞使。
entries.en: On dingsi Feng Dao, Left Vice Director and Grand Counsellor, was made imperial tomb commissioner, with Han Yanyun, Minister of Revenue, as deputy. Wang Yan, Secretariat drafter, was made administrative officer; Wang Quan, Minister of Rites, rites commissioner; Li Ling, Minister of War, guard-of-honor commissioner; Long Min, Vice Censor-in-Chief, ceremony commissioner; and Lu Zhi, Right Vice Director and acting mayor of Henan, bridge-route relay commissioner.
entries.literal: On dingsi Left Vice Director and Grand Counsellor Feng Dao was made imperial tomb commissioner; Minister of Revenue Han Yanyun was made deputy; Secretariat drafter Wang Yan was made administrative officer; Minister of Rites Wang Quan was made rites commissioner; Minister of War Li Ling was made guard-of-honor commissioner; Vice Censor-in-Chief Long Min was made ceremony commissioner; Right Vice Director and acting Mayor of Henan Lu Zhi was made bridge-route relay commissioner.

entries.zh: 庚申，以前相州刺史郝瓊為右驍衛大將軍，充宣徽北院使；
entries.en: On gengshen Hao Qiong, former prefect of Xiangzhou, was made General of the Right Martial Guard and appointed Palace Attendant of the Northern Bureau;
entries.literal: On gengshen former Xiangzhou prefect Hao Qiong was made General of the Right Martial Guard and appointed Palace Attendant of the Northern Bureau;

entries.zh: 以光祿卿、充三司副使王玫為三司使。
entries.en: Wang Mei, Court Provisioner and acting deputy commissioner of the Three Offices, was made commissioner of the Three Offices.
entries.literal: Court Provisioner and acting Deputy Commissioner of the Three Offices Wang Mei was made Commissioner of the Three Offices.

entries.zh: 癸亥，故檢校太尉、右衛上將軍、充三司使孫嶽贈太尉、齊國公。
entries.en: On guihai Sun Yue, late honorary Grand Commandant, General of the Right Guard, and commissioner of the Three Offices, was posthumously made Grand Commandant and Duke of Qi.
entries.literal: On guihai the late honorary Grand Commandant, General of the Right Guard, and Commissioner of the Three Offices Sun Yue was posthumously advanced to Grand Commandant and Duke of Qi.

entries.zh: 丁卯，帝釋縗服，群臣三上表，請復常膳，禦正殿，從之。
entries.en: On dingmao the Emperor put off his mourning garb. The ministers memorialized three times asking him to resume normal meals and hold court in the main hall, and he agreed.
entries.literal: On dingmao the Emperor removed his hemp mourning garments; the ministers thrice memorialized requesting resumption of normal meals and attendance at the main hall; he assented.

entries.zh: 辛未，帝御中興殿，群臣列位，馮道升階進酒。
entries.en: On xinwei the Emperor held court in the Hall of Central Revival with the ministers in their places. Feng Dao mounted the steps and offered wine.
entries.literal: On xinwei the Emperor took the Hall of Central Revival; the ministers took their places; Feng Dao ascended the steps and presented wine.

entries.zh: 帝曰：「比於此物無愛，除賓友之會，不近樽斝。
entries.en: The Emperor said, "I have never cared for this. Except when meeting guests and friends, I do not go near the cup.
entries.literal: The Emperor said: "As for this thing I have no fondness; except at gatherings with guests and friends, I do not approach the wine cup.

entries.zh: 況在沉痛之中，安事飲啖！」
entries.en: And now, in the depths of grief, what place is there for food and drink?"
entries.literal: How much more in the midst of deep grief—what business is there in eating and drinking!"

entries.zh: 命徹之。
entries.en: He ordered it taken away.
entries.literal: He ordered it removed.

entries.zh: 庚辰，宰臣馮道加司空，李愚加右僕射，劉煦加吏部尚書，餘並如故。
entries.en: On gengchen chief minister Feng Dao was made Minister of Works; Li Yu became Right Vice Director; Liu Xu, Minister of Personnel; the rest kept their former posts.
entries.literal: On gengchen chief minister Feng Dao was advanced to Minister of Works; Li Yu was advanced to Right Vice Director; Liu Xu was advanced to Minister of Personnel; the rest remained as before.

entries.zh: 壬午，侍衛親軍馬步軍都指揮使、河陽節度使康義誠加檢校太尉、兼侍中，判六軍諸衛事。
entries.en: On renwu Kang Yicheng, commander of the imperial guard horse and foot and commissioner of Heyang, was made honorary Grand Commandant and concurrent Palace Attendant and given charge of the Six Armies and palace guards.
entries.literal: On renwu Commander of the Imperial Guard horse and foot, Heyang military commissioner Kang Yicheng was advanced honorary Grand Commandant and concurrent Palace Attendant, and was empowered over the Six Armies and various guards.

entries.zh: 甲申，以侍衛馬軍都指揮使、寧國軍節度使安彥威為河中節度使；
entries.en: On jiashen An Yanwei, commander of the imperial cavalry and commissioner of the Ningguo Army, was made commissioner of Hezhong;
entries.literal: On jiashen Commander of the Imperial Guard cavalry, Ningguo Army military commissioner An Yanwei was made Hezhong military commissioner;

entries.zh: 以侍衛步軍都指揮使、忠正軍節度使張從賓為涇州節度使，並加檢校太傅；
entries.en: Zhang Congbin, commander of the imperial infantry and commissioner of the Zhongzheng Army, was made commissioner of Jingzhou; both were advanced honorary Grand Mentor;
entries.literal: Commander of the Imperial Guard infantry, Zhongzheng Army military commissioner Zhang Congbin was made Jingzhou military commissioner, both advanced honorary Grand Mentor;

entries.zh: 以捧聖左右廂都指揮使、欽州刺史朱洪實為寧國軍節度使，加檢校太保，充侍衛馬軍都指揮使；
entries.en: Zhu Hongshi, commander of the left and right wings of the Sacred Guard and prefect of Qinzhou, was made commissioner of the Ningguo Army, advanced honorary Grand Guardian, and appointed commander of the imperial cavalry;
entries.literal: Commander of the left and right wings of the Sacred Guard, Qinzhou prefect Zhu Hongshi was made Ningguo Army military commissioner, advanced honorary Grand Guardian, and appointed Commander of the Imperial Guard cavalry;

entries.zh: 以嚴衛左右廂都指揮使、岩州刺史皇甫遇為忠正軍節度使、檢校太保，充侍衛步軍都指揮使。
entries.en: Huangfu Yu, commander of the left and right wings of the Strict Guard and prefect of Yanzhou, was made commissioner of the Zhongzheng Army and honorary Grand Guardian, and appointed commander of the imperial infantry.
entries.literal: Commander of the left and right wings of the Strict Guard, Yanzhou prefect Huangfu Yu was made Zhongzheng Army military commissioner and honorary Grand Guardian, and appointed Commander of the Imperial Guard infantry.

entries.zh: 戊子，樞密使、檢校太尉、同平章事朱宏昭，樞密使、檢校太尉、同中書門下二品馮贇並加兼中書令。
entries.en: On wuzi Zhu Hongzhao, Military Affairs Commissioner, honorary Grand Commandant, and co-equal Grand Counsellor, and Feng Yun, Military Affairs Commissioner, honorary Grand Commandant, and Second Rank of the Secretariat and Chancellery, were both made concurrent Director of the Secretariat.
entries.literal: On wuzi Military Affairs Commissioners, honorary Grand Commandant, co-equal Grand Counsellor Zhu Hongzhao and Military Affairs Commissioner, honorary Grand Commandant, Second Rank of the Secretariat and Chancellery Feng Yun were both advanced concurrent Director of the Secretariat.

entries.zh: 北京留守、河東節度使兼大同彰國振武威塞等軍蕃漢馬步總管石敬瑭加兼中書令；
entries.en: Shi Jingtang, Beijing regent, Hedong commissioner, and overall commander of Han and non-Han forces of Datong, Zhangguo, Zhenwu, Weisai, and other armies, was made concurrent Director of the Secretariat;
entries.literal: Beijing regent, Hedong military commissioner, and overall commander of Han and non-Han horse and foot of Datong, Zhangguo, Zhenwu, Weisai, and other armies Shi Jingtang was advanced concurrent Director of the Secretariat;

entries.zh: 幽州節度使、檢校太尉、兼中書令趙德鈞加檢校太師、兼中書令。
entries.en: Zhao Dejun, commissioner of Youzhou, honorary Grand Commandant, and concurrent Director of the Secretariat, was advanced honorary Grand Preceptor while retaining the directorship.
entries.literal: Youzhou military commissioner, honorary Grand Commandant, and concurrent Director of the Secretariat Zhao Dejun was advanced honorary Grand Preceptor and concurrent Director of the Secretariat.

entries.zh: 樞密使馮贇表堅讓中書令，製改兼侍中，封邠國公。
entries.en: Feng Yun, Military Affairs Commissioner, firmly declined the directorship in a memorial. An edict changed the appointment to concurrent Palace Attendant and enfeoffed him as Duke of Bin.
entries.literal: Military Affairs Commissioner Feng Yun memorialized firmly declining the Directorship of the Secretariat; an edict changed it to concurrent Palace Attendant and enfeoffed him Duke of Bin.

entries.zh: 庚寅，鳳翔節度使、潞王從珂加兼侍中；
entries.en: On gengyin Congke, Prince of Lu and commissioner of Fengxiang, was made concurrent Palace Attendant;
entries.literal: On gengyin Fengxiang military commissioner, Prince of Lu Congke was advanced concurrent Palace Attendant;

entries.zh: 青州節度使、檢校太尉、兼中書令房知溫加檢校太師。
entries.en: Fang Zhiwen, commissioner of Qingzhou, honorary Grand Commandant, and concurrent Director of the Secretariat, was advanced honorary Grand Preceptor.
entries.literal: Qingzhou military commissioner, honorary Grand Commandant, and concurrent Director of the Secretariat Fang Zhiwen was advanced honorary Grand Preceptor.

entries.zh: 辛卯，以翰林學士承旨、尚書右丞李懌為工部尚書，以秘書監盧文紀為太常卿，充山陵禮儀使。
entries.en: On xinmao Li Yi, Hanlin Academician Exemplar and Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, was made Minister of Works; Lu Wenji, Director of the Palace Library, was made Grand Minister of Rites and appointed imperial tomb rites commissioner.
entries.literal: On xinmao Hanlin Academician Exemplar and Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs Li Yi was made Minister of Works; Director of the Palace Library Lu Wenji was made Grand Minister of Rites and appointed imperial tomb rites commissioner.

entries.zh: 壬辰，荊南節度使、檢校太尉、兼中書令高從誨封南平王；
entries.en: On renchen Gao Conghui, commissioner of Jingnan, honorary Grand Commandant, and concurrent Director of the Secretariat, was enfeoffed Prince of Nanping;
entries.literal: On renchen Jingnan military commissioner, honorary Grand Commandant, and concurrent Director of the Secretariat Gao Conghui was enfeoffed Prince of Nanping;

entries.zh: 湖南節度使、檢校太尉、兼中書令馬希範封楚王。
entries.en: Ma Xifan, commissioner of Hunan, honorary Grand Commandant, and concurrent Director of the Secretariat, was enfeoffed Prince of Chu.
entries.literal: Hunan military commissioner, honorary Grand Commandant, and concurrent Director of the Secretariat Ma Xifan was enfeoffed Prince of Chu.

entries.zh: 甲午，兩浙節度使、檢校太師、守中書令、吳王錢元瓘進封吳越王；
entries.en: On jiawu Qian Yuanguan, commissioner of Liang-Zhe, honorary Grand Preceptor, Acting Director of the Secretariat, and Prince of Wu, was advanced and enfeoffed King of Wuyue;
entries.literal: On jiawu Liang-Zhe military commissioner, honorary Grand Preceptor, Acting Director of the Secretariat, Prince of Wu Qian Yuanguan was advanced and enfeoffed King of Wuyue;

entries.zh: 前洺州團練使皇甫立加檢校太保，充鄜州節度使；
entries.en: Huangfu Li, former training commissioner of Mingzhou, was advanced honorary Grand Guardian and made commissioner of Fuzhou;
entries.literal: Former Mingzhou training commissioner Huangfu Li was advanced honorary Grand Guardian and appointed Fuzhou military commissioner;

entries.zh: 前彰義軍節度使康福加檢校太傅，充邠州節度使；
entries.en: Kang Fu, former commissioner of the Zhangyi Army, was advanced honorary Grand Mentor and made commissioner of Binzhou;
entries.literal: Former Zhangyi Army military commissioner Kang Fu was advanced honorary Grand Mentor and appointed Binzhou military commissioner;

entries.zh: 劍南東、西兩川節度使、檢校太尉、兼中書令、蜀王孟知祥加檢校太師。
entries.en: Meng Zhixiang, commissioner of the Eastern and Western Circuits of Jiannan, honorary Grand Commandant, concurrent Director of the Secretariat, and Prince of Shu, was advanced honorary Grand Preceptor.
entries.literal: Military commissioner of the Eastern and Western Circuits of Jiannan, honorary Grand Commandant, concurrent Director of the Secretariat, and Prince of Shu Meng Zhixiang was advanced honorary Grand Preceptor.

entries.zh: 製下，知祥辭不受命。
entries.en: When the edict was issued, Zhixiang declined the appointment.
entries.literal: When the edict was issued, Zhixiang declined and did not accept the appointment.

entries.zh: 丙申，鎮州節度使、檢校太尉、兼侍中範延光，汴州節度使、檢校太尉、兼侍中趙延壽，並加檢校太師。
entries.en: On bingshen Fan Yanguang, commissioner of Zhenzhou, honorary Grand Commandant, and concurrent Palace Attendant, and Zhao Yanshou, commissioner of Bianzhou, honorary Grand Commandant, and concurrent Palace Attendant, were both advanced honorary Grand Preceptor.
entries.literal: On bingshen Zhenzhou military commissioner, honorary Grand Commandant, and concurrent Palace Attendant Fan Yanguang and Bianzhou military commissioner, honorary Grand Commandant, and concurrent Palace Attendant Zhao Yanshou were both advanced honorary Grand Preceptor.

entries.zh: 戊戌，山南西道節度使、檢校太傅、同平章事張虔釗，襄州節度使趙在禮，並加檢校太尉。
entries.en: On wuxu Zhang Qianzhao, commissioner of the Shannan West Circuit, honorary Grand Mentor, and co-equal Grand Counsellor, and Zhao Zaili, commissioner of Xiangzhou, were both advanced honorary Grand Commandant.
entries.literal: On wuxu Shannan West Circuit military commissioner, honorary Grand Mentor, and co-equal Grand Counsellor Zhang Qianzhao and Xiangzhou military commissioner Zhao Zaili were both advanced honorary Grand Commandant.

entries.zh: 辛丑，以振武軍節度使、安北都護楊檀兼大同、彰國、振武、威塞等軍都虞候，充北面馬軍都指揮使。
entries.en: On xinchou Yang Tan, commissioner of the Zhenwu Army and Protector-General of Pacifying the North, was made concurrent chief commandant of Datong, Zhangguo, Zhenwu, Weisai, and other armies and appointed commander of northern-front cavalry.
entries.literal: On xinchou Zhenwu Army military commissioner and Protector-General of Pacifying the North Yang Tan was made concurrent Chief Commandant of Datong, Zhangguo, Zhenwu, Weisai, and other armies, and appointed Northern Front cavalry commander.

entries.zh: 二月乙亥，以前鎮州節度使、涇王從敏為宋州節度使。
entries.en: On yihai of the second month Congmin, Prince of Jing and former commissioner of Zhenzhou, was made commissioner of Songzhou.
entries.literal: Second month yihai: former Zhenzhou military commissioner, Prince of Jing Congmin was made Songzhou military commissioner.

entries.zh: 己卯，以前徐州節度使、檢校太傅李敬周為安州節度使。
entries.en: On jimao Li Jingzhou, former commissioner of Xuzhou and honorary Grand Mentor, was made commissioner of Anzhou.
entries.literal: On jimao former Xuzhou military commissioner, honorary Grand Mentor Li Jingzhou was made Anzhou military commissioner.

entries.zh: 是日，宣授鳳翔節度使、潞王從珂為權北京留守；
entries.en: That same day Congke, Prince of Lu and commissioner of Fengxiang, was proclaimed acting Beijing regent;
entries.literal: That day by proclamation Fengxiang military commissioner, Prince of Lu Congke was appointed acting Beijing regent;

entries.zh: 以北京留守石敬瑭權知鎮州軍州事；
entries.en: Shi Jingtang, Beijing regent, was made acting administrator of Zhenzhou;
entries.literal: Beijing regent Shi Jingtang was appointed acting administrator of Zhenzhou military and civil affairs;

entries.zh: 以鎮州範延光權知鄴都留守事；
entries.en: Fan Yanguang of Zhenzhou was made acting regent of Yedu;
entries.literal: Zhenzhou Fan Yanguang was appointed acting regent of Yedu;

entries.zh: 以前河中節度使、洋王從璋權知鳳翔軍軍府事。
entries.en: Congzhang, Prince of Yang and former commissioner of Hezhong, was made acting administrator of Fengxiang headquarters.
entries.literal: Former Hezhong military commissioner, Prince of Yang Congzhang was appointed acting administrator of Fengxiang Army headquarters affairs.

entries.zh: 庚寅，幸山陵工作所。
entries.en: On gengyin he visited the imperial tomb construction site.
entries.literal: On gengyin he visited the imperial tomb construction site.

entries.zh: 是日，西京留守王思同奏，鳳翔節度使、潞王從珂拒命。
entries.en: That day Wang Sitong, regent of the Western Capital, reported that Congke, Prince of Lu and commissioner of Fengxiang, had refused orders.
entries.literal: That day Western Capital regent Wang Sitong memorialized that Fengxiang military commissioner, Prince of Lu Congke had refused orders.

entries.zh: 丁酉，王思同加同平章事，充西面行營都部署；
entries.en: On dingyou Wang Sitong was made co-equal Grand Counsellor and appointed supreme commander of the western campaign;
entries.literal: On dingyou Wang Sitong was advanced co-equal Grand Counsellor and appointed supreme commander of the western campaign headquarters;

entries.zh: 以前邠州節度使藥彥稠為副部署。
entries.en: Yao Yanchou, former commissioner of Binzhou, was made deputy commander.
entries.literal: Former Binzhou military commissioner Yao Yanchou was made deputy commander.

entries.zh: 以河中節度使安彥威為西面兵馬都監，以前定州節度使李德充為權北京留守。
entries.en: An Yanwei, commissioner of Hezhong, was made inspector of armies and horses for the western campaign; Li Dechong, former commissioner of Dingzhou, was made acting Beijing regent.
entries.literal: Hezhong military commissioner An Yanwei was made western campaign inspector of armies and horses; former Dingzhou military commissioner Li Dechong was appointed acting Beijing regent.

entries.zh: 山陵使奏：「伏睹御劄，皇帝親奉靈駕至園陵。
entries.en: The imperial tomb commissioner reported, "We have seen the imperial note that Your Majesty will personally escort the spirit carriage to the imperial park tomb.
entries.literal: The imperial tomb commissioner memorialized: "We have respectfully seen the imperial note that the Emperor will personally escort the spirit carriage to the imperial park tomb.

entries.zh: 伏見累朝故事，人君無親送葬之儀，請車駕不行。」
entries.en: By the precedents of successive dynasties, no sovereign has ever personally escorted a burial. We ask that the imperial carriage not go."
entries.literal: We have seen the precedents of successive dynasties: sovereigns have no rite of personally escorting the burial; we request that the imperial carriage not go."

entries.zh: 不從。
entries.en: The Emperor did not agree.
entries.literal: He did not assent.

entries.zh: 乙未，樞密使馮贇起復視事，時贇丁母憂也。
entries.en: On yiwei Feng Yun, Military Affairs Commissioner, was recalled from mourning to resume office; he was then in mourning for his mother.
entries.literal: On yiwei Military Affairs Commissioner Feng Yun was recalled from mourning to resume office; at the time Yun was in mourning for his mother.

entries.zh: 己亥，以司農卿張鎛為殿中監。
entries.en: On jihai Zhang Bo, Director of the Court of the Imperial Granaries, was made Director of the Palace Domestic Service.
entries.literal: On jihai Director of the Court of the Imperial Granaries Zhang Bo was made Director of the Palace Domestic Service.

entries.zh: 庚子，殿直楚匡祚上言，監取亳州團練使李重吉至宋州，係於軍院。
entries.en: On gengzi Chu Kuangzuo, Palace Guard, reported that he had escorted Li Chongji, training commissioner of Bozhou, to Songzhou and detained him in the military compound.
entries.literal: On gengzi Palace Guard Chu Kuangzuo memorialized that he had escorted Bozhou training commissioner Li Chongji to Songzhou and detained him in the military compound.

entries.zh: 重吉，潞王之長子，及幽於宋州，帝猶以金帛賜之，及聞西師鹹叛，方遣使殺之。
entries.en: Chongji was the Prince of Lu's eldest son. Though he was imprisoned at Songzhou, the Emperor still sent him gold and silk; only when he heard that the entire western army had rebelled did he dispatch envoys to kill him.
entries.literal: Chongji was the Prince of Lu's eldest son; though imprisoned at Songzhou, the Emperor still sent him gold and silk; only upon hearing that the western army had all rebelled did he dispatch envoys to kill him.

entries.zh: 三月甲辰，以前太僕少卿魏仁鍔為太僕卿。
entries.en: On jiachen of the third month Wei Ren'e, former Vice Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud, was made its minister.
entries.literal: Third month jiachen: former Vice Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud Wei Ren'e was made Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud.

entries.zh: 興元節度使張虔釗奏，會合討鳳翔。
entries.en: Zhang Qianzhao, commissioner of Xingyuan, reported that he would join the campaign against Fengxiang.
entries.literal: Xingyuan military commissioner Zhang Qianzhao memorialized that he would join forces to attack Fengxiang.

entries.zh: 丙午，以右領衛上將軍武延翰為郢州刺史。
entries.en: On bingwu Wu Yanhan, General of the Right Leading Guard, was made prefect of Yingzhou.
entries.literal: On bingwu General of the Right Leading Guard Wu Yanhan was made Yingzhou prefect.

entries.zh: 丁未，洋州孫漢韶奏，至興元與張虔釗同議進軍。
entries.en: On dingwei Sun Hanshao of Yangzhou reported that he had reached Xingyuan and agreed with Zhang Qianzhao on advancing the army.
entries.literal: On dingwei Yangzhou Sun Hanshao memorialized that he had reached Xingyuan and jointly deliberated advancing the army with Zhang Qianzhao.

entries.zh: 己酉，以鎮州節度使範延光依前檢校太師、兼侍中，行興唐尹，充天雄軍節度使、北面水陸轉運製置使；
entries.en: On jiyou Fan Yanguang, commissioner of Zhenzhou, retained his honorary Grand Preceptor rank and concurrent Palace Attendant post, was made acting mayor of Xingtang, and appointed commissioner of the Tianxiong Army and northern-front water-and-land transport commissioner;
entries.literal: On jiyou Zhenzhou military commissioner Fan Yanguang, as before honorary Grand Preceptor and concurrent Palace Attendant, was made acting Mayor of Xingtang and appointed Tianxiong Army military commissioner and northern-front water-and-land transport commissioner;

entries.zh: 以北京留守、河東節度使石敬瑭依前檢校太尉、兼中書令，其真定尹、充鎮州節度使、大同彰國振武威塞等軍蕃漢馬步總管如故。
entries.en: Shi Jingtang, Beijing regent and Hedong commissioner, retained his honorary Grand Commandant rank and concurrent Directorship, and kept his posts as mayor of Zhending, commissioner of Zhenzhou, and overall commander of Han and non-Han forces of Datong, Zhangguo, Zhenwu, Weisai, and other armies.
entries.literal: Beijing regent and Hedong military commissioner Shi Jingtang, as before honorary Grand Commandant and concurrent Director of the Secretariat, retained his posts as Mayor of Zhending, Zhenzhou military commissioner, and overall commander of Han and non-Han horse and foot of Datong, Zhangguo, Zhenwu, Weisai, and other armies.

entries.zh: 辛亥，以前定州節度使李德充為北京留守，充河東節度使。
entries.en: On xinhai Li Dechong, former commissioner of Dingzhou, was made Beijing regent and commissioner of Hedong.
entries.literal: On xinhai former Dingzhou military commissioner Li Dechong was made Beijing regent and appointed Hedong military commissioner.

entries.zh: 許王從益加檢校太保，前河中節度使、洋王從璋加檢校太傅。
entries.en: Congyi, Prince of Xu, was advanced honorary Grand Guardian; Congzhang, Prince of Yang and former commissioner of Hezhong, was advanced honorary Grand Mentor.
entries.literal: Prince of Xu Congyi was advanced honorary Grand Guardian; former Hezhong military commissioner, Prince of Yang Congzhang was advanced honorary Grand Mentor.

entries.zh: 詔：「藩侯帶平章事以上薨，許立神道碑，差官撰文。
entries.en: An edict declared, "When a frontier lord of Grand Counsellor rank or above dies, he may be granted a spirit-way stele, and officials shall be dispatched to compose the inscription.
entries.literal: Edict: "When a frontier lord bearing Grand Counsellor rank or above dies, he may be granted a spirit-way stele; officials shall be dispatched to compose the text.

entries.zh: 未帶平章事及刺史，準令式合立碑者，其文任自製撰，不在奏聞。」
entries.en: For those who did not hold Grand Counsellor rank or who served as prefects, but who were eligible under regulations to erect steles, the text could be composed at their own discretion without submitting it for imperial review."
entries.literal: Those not bearing Grand Counsellor rank and [those who are] prefects, where regulations permit erecting steles, may compose the text themselves and need not memorialize it to the throne."

entries.zh: 乙卯，興元張虔釗奏，自鎮將兵赴鳳翔，收大散關。
entries.en: On yimao Zhang Qianzhao of Xingyuan reported that he would lead troops from his commission to Fengxiang and recover Dasan Pass.
entries.literal: On yimao Zhang Qianzhao of Xingyuan memorialized that he would lead troops from his post to Fengxiang and recover Dasan Pass.

entries.zh: 宗正寺奏：「準故事，諸陵有令、丞各一員，近例更委本縣令兼之。
entries.en: The Court of the Imperial Clan reported, "By established precedent each imperial tomb had one director and one vice-director, but recent practice had the local county magistrate hold both posts concurrently.
entries.literal: The Court of the Imperial Clan memorialized: "Per precedent, each imperial tomb had one director and one vice-director; in recent practice the local county magistrate has been made to hold both posts concurrently.

entries.zh: 緣河南洛陽是京邑，兼令、丞不便。」
entries.en: Because Luoyang in Henan was the capital, having one man serve as both director and vice-director was impracticable."
entries.literal: Because Luoyang in Henan is the capital, concurrent service as director and vice-director is inconvenient."

entries.zh: 詔特置陵台令、丞各一員。
entries.en: An edict then specially established one director and one vice-director for the Tomb Platform.
entries.literal: An edict specially established one director and one vice-director for the Tomb Platform.

entries.zh: 己未，以前金吾大將軍李肅為左衛上將軍，充山陵修奉上下宮都部署。
entries.en: On jiwei Li Su, former Grand General of the Gold Crow Guard, was made General of the Left Guard and appointed overall director of repair and maintenance for the upper and lower palace tombs.
entries.literal: On jiwei former Grand General of the Gold Crow Guard Li Su was made General of the Left Guard and appointed overall director of upper and lower palace tomb repair and maintenance.

entries.zh: 是月二十九日夜，帝至衛州東七八里，遇騎從自東來不避，左右叱之，乃曰：「鎮州節度使石敬瑭也。」
entries.en: On the night of the twenty-ninth of that month the Emperor reached a point seven or eight li east of Weizhou and met horsemen riding from the east who did not give way. When attendants shouted at them, they answered, "It is Shi Jingtang, military commissioner of Zhenzhou."
entries.literal: On the night of the twenty-ninth of that month the Emperor reached seven or eight li east of Weizhou and encountered horsemen coming from the east who did not give way; attendants shouted at them, and they said: "It is Zhenzhou military commissioner Shi Jingtang."

entries.zh: 帝喜，敬瑭拜舞於路，帝下馬慟哭，諭以「潞王危社稷，康義誠以下叛我，無以自庇，長公主見教，逆爾於路，謀社稷大計。」
entries.en: The Emperor rejoiced. Jingtang bowed and danced in the road. The Emperor dismounted and wept bitterly, telling him, "The Prince of Lu endangers the realm. Kang Yicheng and those below have betrayed me, and I have no means to protect myself. The Grand Princess gave me counsel and sent me to meet you on the road to plan the great design for the realm."
entries.literal: The Emperor rejoiced. Jingtang bowed and danced in the road; the Emperor dismounted and wept bitterly, telling him: "The Prince of Lu endangers the realm; Kang Yicheng and those below have betrayed me—I have no means to protect myself; the Grand Princess gave counsel and sent me to meet you on the road to deliberate the great design for the realm."

entries.zh: 敬瑭曰：「衛州王宏贄宿舊諳事，且就宏贄圖之。」
